paper.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes
paper.abstract: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency. Our key insight is that LLM failure modes exhibit structured patterns across model scales within the same family. Instead of treating failures

summary.core_problem: 如何在推理阶段以极低的额外成本提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，避免传统推理时缩放（如重复采样、外部验证）带来的高昂开销。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于弱到强泛化（weak-to-strong generalization）的推理时优化框架 CritICL。该方法不依赖于强模型的重复生成，而是利用同系列弱模型的结构化失败模式（failure modes）来指导强模型，为高效提升推理能力提供了一种新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 核心洞察是同系列模型（如 Qwen 1.5B 和 72B）在不同规模下表现出高度一致的失败模式分布。CritICL 首先离线构建 CritBank，收集弱模型在特定问题上的错误回答、失败模式标签和自然语言批评（critique）。在推理时，CritICL 提供两种变体：动态版（CritICL-dynamic）根据输入预测可能的失败模式并检索相关 critique；静态版（CritICL-static）直接使用该模型系列最常见的失败模式对应的 critique。这些 critique 作为上下文示例（in-context examples）输入给强模型，指导其避免常见错误。
summary.experiments: 在 GSM8K、MATH、AMC 和 AIME 等数学推理基准上，CritICL 稳定优于标准的上下文学习（ICL），并在显著降低生成次数和 token 成本的情况下，匹配或超越了现有的测试时缩放方法。进一步分析表明，该方法可泛化至数学推理之外的其他领域。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 CritBank 的构建过程（Section 3）以及弱模型与强模型失败模式一致性的实证分析（Section 4.1）。对比 CritICL 动态版和静态版的性能差异也是一个有趣的观察点。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) at inference time with minimal additional cost, avoiding the high overhead associated with traditional inference-time scaling methods like repeated sampling or external verification.
summary_en.importance: Introduces CritICL, an inference-time optimization framework based on weak-to-strong generalization. Instead of relying on repeated generations from strong models, it leverages the structured failure modes of weaker models from the same family to guide stronger models, offering a novel approach for efficient reasoning enhancement.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core insight is that models within the same family (e.g., Qwen 1.5B and 72B) exhibit highly consistent distributions of failure modes across different scales. CritICL first constructs CritBank offline, collecting incorrect responses, failure mode labels, and natural language critiques from weak models on specific questions. During inference, CritICL offers two variants: a dynamic version (CritICL-dynamic) that predicts likely failure modes for the input and retrieves relevant critiques, and a static version (CritICL-static) that uses critiques associated with the most common failure modes for that model family. These critiques are provided as in-context examples to guide the strong model away from common pitfalls.
summary_en.experiments: On math reasoning benchmarks including GSM8K, MATH, AMC, and AIME, CritICL consistently outperforms standard in-context learning (ICL) and matches or exceeds existing test-time scaling methods while requiring significantly fewer generations and lower token costs. Further analysis shows the method generalizes beyond mathematical reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the construction of CritBank (Section 3) and the empirical analysis demonstrating the consistency of failure modes between weak and strong models (Section 4.1). Comparing the performance of the dynamic and static variants of CritICL is also insightful.

recommendation.zh: 利用小模型的失败模式作为 ICL 示例来指导大模型推理，一种有趣的 inference-time weak-to-strong 尝试，关注其构建 critique 示例的具体方法。
recommendation.en: Uses failure modes of small models as ICL examples to guide large model inference. An interesting attempt at inference-time weak-to-strong generalization; pay attention to the specific method of constructing critique examples.

paper.title: Reasoning about In-Context Samples for Machine-Translation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trained to perform chain-of-thoughts reasoning in order to improve the reliability of their responses. In this work, we investigate how explicit reasoning can be leveraged for LLM-Based Machine Translation (MT) with in-context samples. We introduce a novel fragment-based reasoning framework in which the model first extracts parallel source-target fragments from retrieved similar exemplars, and uses these fragments as intermediate reasoning traces to produce th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究如何让 LLM 在机器翻译的 in-context learning 中显式利用检索到的示例，并通过中间推理痕迹提升翻译质量。
summary.importance: 它的价值主要在后训练与推理范式：把 CoT 风格中间步骤迁移到 MT 场景，并把 exemplar 使用从“直接拼接”改成“先抽片段再生成”。这对理解检索样本如何被模型消费有一定启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 fragment-based reasoning framework：先从检索到的相似双语示例中抽取 source-target parallel fragments，把这些片段作为中间 reasoning traces，再生成最终译文。训练时使用大教师模型蒸馏 silver fragments 和 drafts，学生模型基于这些中间监督学习如何组织 exemplar 证据。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3 系列模型，在 6 种语言、每种最多 5 个领域上评估，与标准 k-shot 和 basic drafting 等方法比较。摘要声称 fragment-based MT 明显优于这些基线，但未给出参数规模、数据规模和具体提升数值。整体更像任务型后训练方法，而不是通用预训练结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to make LLM-based machine translation use retrieved in-context examples more explicitly through intermediate reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in post-training and inference design: it transfers CoT-style intermediate reasoning to MT and replaces direct exemplar concatenation with fragment extraction followed by generation. This offers some insight into how retrieved examples are consumed, but it is still far from core pretraining work.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a fragment-based reasoning framework: first extract parallel source-target fragments from retrieved similar bilingual exemplars, then use those fragments as intermediate reasoning traces to produce the final translation. Training relies on a large teacher model to distill silver fragments and drafts, giving the student explicit intermediate supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use the Qwen3 family across 6 languages and up to 5 domains per language, comparing against standard k-shot prompting and basic drafting. The abstract claims consistent gains for fragment-based MT, but does not provide model sizes, data scales, or exact margins. Overall, this is a task-oriented post-training method rather than a general pretraining result.

recommendation.zh: 更像 MT 场景下的蒸馏式 prompt engineering；若你关心 exemplar 如何被模型消费，可只看中间监督设计，别把结论外推到通用推理。
recommendation.en: This is closer to distilled prompt engineering for MT; read it only if you care about how exemplars are consumed, and do not overgeneralize the result to broad reasoning.

paper.title: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
paper.abstract: Zero-shot cross-task generalization, where a policy must execute manipulation tasks never seen during training, remains a central challenge in robot learning. In large language models, a novel task can be performed simply by specifying it in the context, without any parameter update. This form of in-context learning (ICL) turns generalization into a problem of task specification. To achieve cross-task generalization, we bring this paradigm to robotic manipulation, and argue that the natural task

summary.core_problem: 如何让机器人策略在不更新参数的情况下，通过上下文学习（ICL）执行未见过的操作任务？
summary.importance: 将 LLM 的 In-Context Learning 范式引入机器人操作，通过人类视频作为 task specification，探索了跨模态（视频到动作）的 zero-shot 泛化，对多模态具身智能的预训练范式有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Zero-WAM，一个因果视频-动作模型。它将人类视频作为上下文指导来执行未见过的任务。为了解决成对的人机数据稀缺问题，提出一个自动 pipeline，将机器人轨迹转换为语义匹配的人类视频，构建了包含 74.2K 个 ICL 对的数据集 HumanGen。
summary.experiments: 构建了 HumanGen 数据集，并在未见过的任务上验证了 Zero-WAM 的 zero-shot 泛化能力（具体指标未在摘要中详述）。
summary.authors_note: Yujun Shen 参与，可能来自蚂蚁集团或相关机构。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable robot policies to execute unseen manipulation tasks via in-context learning (ICL) without parameter updates?
summary_en.importance: Introduces the In-Context Learning paradigm from LLMs to robotic manipulation, using human videos as task specifications to explore cross-modal (video-to-action) zero-shot generalization, inspiring multimodal embodied AI pretraining paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Zero-WAM, a causal video-action model that executes unseen tasks by following in-context human video guidance. To address the scarcity of paired human-robot data, an automatic pipeline is proposed to convert robot trajectories into semantically matched human videos, yielding the HumanGen dataset with 74.2K ICL pairs.
summary_en.experiments: Constructed the HumanGen dataset and validated Zero-WAM's zero-shot generalization on unseen tasks (specific metrics not detailed in the abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Involves Yujun Shen, likely from Ant Group or related institutions.

recommendation.zh: 将 ICL 范式平移到具身智能，用人类视频做 prompt 指导机器人动作，其数据合成 pipeline (HumanGen) 值得关注多模态对齐的研究员一读。
recommendation.en: Translates the ICL paradigm to embodied AI, using human videos as prompts to guide robot actions. Its data synthesis pipeline (HumanGen) is worth reading for researchers focusing on multimodal alignment.

paper.title: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful but limited by static parametric knowledge that becomes outdated once pretraining ends. Knowledge editing addresses this problem by updating model behavior on target facts without full retraining. In particular, in-context knowledge editing has gained attention because it is training-free and readily applicable to black-box LLMs. Recent reinforcement learning (RL)-based approaches improve over fixed retrieval strategies by adapting prompt construction to

summary.core_problem: 改进 in-context knowledge editing，使黑盒 LLM 在不更新参数的情况下更可靠地使用新事实，同时保持泛化和特异性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练 / 推理时提示策略优化；它关注预训练结束后参数知识过期的问题，但方法落点是 prompt demonstration 组织和 RL 策略，不直接改变基座训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Multi-Objective In-context Knowledge Editing（MO-IKE），用多目标强化学习把提示构造成结构化决策过程，显式权衡 reliability、generality、specificity，并覆盖 demonstration 的全局组织，而不是只优化单一目标或局部检索选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、知识编辑数据集、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度；只说明其针对既有固定检索和单目标 RL 方法的局限提出改进。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve in-context knowledge editing for black-box LLMs without parameter updates, balancing reliability, generalization, and specificity.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training or inference-time prompt optimization contribution. The motivation is stale parametric knowledge after pretraining, but the method operates through demonstration selection and organization rather than base-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: MO-IKE formulates prompt construction as a structured multi-objective reinforcement learning problem. It explicitly balances reliability, generality, and specificity and makes decisions over the global organization of demonstrations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. It positions the method against fixed retrieval strategies and earlier single-objective RL approaches.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 只有间接价值；若关心参数知识过期，读多目标 reward 设计即可，别把它当知识注入方案。
recommendation.en: Only indirectly useful for pretraining; if stale knowledge matters, read the multi-objective reward design, but do not treat this as a parametric knowledge-update method.

paper.title: Taming Visual Neglect: A Variational Information Bottleneck Framework for Adaptive Attention in Multimodal In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models exhibit strong in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, yet when and why visual context helps multimodal ICL remains poorly understood. Empirical studies show a puzzling dichotomy: models sometimes effectively leverage visual demonstrations, yet often neglect them entirely. We propose VIB-ICL, an information-theoretic framework that resolves this dichotomy through the Information Bottleneck principle. We introduce the Cross-Modal Information Gain (CMIG), which quantif

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是解释多模态 in-context learning 中的视觉上下文何时有用、何时会被模型忽略。该工作把“visual neglect”从单纯的模型缺陷重新表述为一个条件信息量问题：如果图像相对于文本和示例集不能提供额外标签信息，忽略视觉输入可能是合理的。
summary.importance: 对多模态预训练和 VLM 行为分析的启发在于，它给视觉 token 利用率提供了一个可检验的判据，而不是只看 attention heatmap 或任务准确率。对基座研究更直接的价值是：多模态数据并不因为包含图像就一定增加有效监督，关键是图像相对于文本的条件增益。这个视角可用于解释图文冗余数据、caption 过强数据、视觉示例选择，以及多模态 ICL 中的 modality collapse。贡献偏理论框架和诊断方法，离直接改变预训练 recipe 还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 Information Bottleneck。作者定义 Cross-Modal Information Gain，记为 ΔI = I(V; Y | T, D) - I(V; Y | T)，用来度量在给定文本 T 和 demonstration set D 后，视觉信息 V 对目标标签 Y 还能提供多少额外信息。理论部分给出一个泛化界：多模态 ICL 相对 text-only ICL 的 excess risk 由 -ΔI/(2σ_y²) 加上样本复杂度项控制，因此当 ΔI 为正且样本量足够时，视觉上下文应当带来收益。另一个结果说明，当 ΔI 小于 IB 正则强度 λ_IB 时，视觉忽略是 IB 最优解。作者进一步导出自适应视觉注意力权重 α_v* = max(0, 1 - λ_IB / I(V; Y | T))。算法层面，VIB-ICL 先用变分下界估计 CMIG，再按理论公式重分配视觉注意力，并选择 CMIG 较高的 demonstrations。相比直接增加视觉示例或手工调 attention，它的区别是把示例选择和注意力分配绑定到条件互信息估计上。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个多模态 ICL benchmark。作者报告 VIB-ICL 相比已有方法有稳定提升，最高 accuracy gain 为 4.7%，并可减少约 35% 所需 demonstrations。实验主线包括三类验证：CMIG 是否能预测视觉上下文收益；自适应视觉注意力是否优于固定使用图像；按 CMIG 选择 demonstrations 是否优于普通检索或随机选择。由于可见全文片段没有给出完整表格，需要精读实验部分确认不同 benchmark、不同 LVLM 架构和不同 shot 数下的增益是否均匀，以及变分互信息估计是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。优先看 Definition 1、Theorem 7、Theorem 9 和 Corollary 10，理解 CMIG、泛化界和视觉忽略条件。Figure 1 可以快速把理论变量和算法流程对上。实验部分重点看 CMIG 与性能提升的相关性、attention reallocation 的消融、demonstration selection 的消融。如果只关心预训练启发，可以重点看“文本已足够强时视觉 token 为什么失效”这一点，而不是细读所有证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when visual demonstrations actually help multimodal in-context learning, and when large vision-language models rationally ignore them. It frames visual neglect as a conditional information problem rather than treating it only as an attention failure.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the separation between multimodal input volume and effective cross-modal supervision. Images do not necessarily add training or inference signal if the text already explains the label. This matters for multimodal data mixture design, caption-heavy datasets, visual token utilization analysis, and demonstration retrieval for LVLMs. The contribution is mainly a theoretical and diagnostic framework, not a direct pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on the Information Bottleneck principle. It defines Cross-Modal Information Gain as ΔI = I(V; Y | T, D) - I(V; Y | T), measuring the extra label information carried by visual context beyond text and demonstrations. The main bound states that the excess risk of multimodal ICL over text-only ICL is controlled by a negative CMIG term, -ΔI/(2σ_y²), plus a sample complexity term. Positive CMIG therefore predicts a benefit from visual context. A second result shows that visual neglect is IB-optimal when ΔI is below the bottleneck penalty λ_IB. The derived attention rule sets the visual attention weight to α_v* = max(0, 1 - λ_IB / I(V; Y | T)). The instantiated VIB-ICL algorithm estimates CMIG through a variational lower bound, reallocates visual attention, and selects demonstrations with high cross-modal information gain.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on five multimodal ICL benchmarks. VIB-ICL achieves consistent gains, with up to 4.7% accuracy improvement and a 35% reduction in the number of demonstrations needed. The relevant experimental checks are whether CMIG predicts when visual context helps, whether adaptive visual attention beats fixed use of images, and whether CMIG-based demonstration selection improves over standard selection strategies. The available text does not expose all tables, so the robustness across tasks, model families, and shot counts should be verified from the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25 minutes. Focus on Definition 1, Theorem 7, Theorem 9, Corollary 10, and Figure 1. These parts contain the main conceptual contribution. Then check the ablations for CMIG estimation, attention reallocation, and demonstration selection. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful angle is the explanation of why visually grounded data can still yield weak visual usage when text is already sufficiently informative.

recommendation.zh: 可读 §理论部分：它把视觉忽略解释成最优压缩，不一定对训练 recipe 有用，但能修正 VLM ICL 的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the theory sections: treating visual neglect as optimal compression is a useful prior correction, even if it is not a training recipe.

paper.title: Shortcut Before Circuit: Document Statistics Time In-Context Conflict Resolution
paper.abstract: When a context asserts two values for one fact, a model commits to a cue -- recency, repetition, position -- but natural data rarely makes these disagree, so behavior cannot reveal which. We train 26M-parameter transformers on a synthetic language where recency and rarity are exactly coextensive, and separate them with a minimal causal edit that inverts one cue while holding the truth, token count and answer position fixed. All 75 runs reach accuracy >= 0.999, including where the trivial heurist

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体但很关键的问题：当训练语料里的多个统计线索总是共现时，模型最终学到的到底是哪一种机制，能不能从常规准确率或常规 probe 里可靠识别出来。作者构造了一个合成赋值语言，任务始终是回答某个 slot 当前的最新值，但训练分布里“最新值”与“最稀有值”被设计成严格等价，因此目标函数对“按时间检索”与“按频次/稀有度启发式”两类机制完全无偏好。论文要解决的不是模型能否把题做对，而是：在目标函数对多种机制无差别时，机制归因是否天然不稳定；以及语料统计究竟决定了什么，没决定什么。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于给机制分析和训练动态研究加了一个边界条件。结论很明确：如果训练分布让两种规则在经验风险上完全等价，那么即使模型在 held-in 数据上几乎满分，也不能据此断言它学到了哪一种内部机制；可被稳定归因的，往往只是某种能力出现的时机，而不是具体电路的唯一形态。这对解释 LLM 在冲突上下文、文档更新、检索污染、重复偏置等现象时很重要。很多看似在测‘模型偏好 recency 还是 frequency’的分析，若没有打破训练分布中的共线性，结论可能只是观测幻觉。对预训练数据研究也有直接启发：数据分布不仅决定性能，还决定哪些机制是可识别的，哪些只能在干预下讨论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很干净。文档由若干四元 token 语句 [ent] [attr] [val] [SEP] 组成，最后追加查询 [QUERY] [ent] [attr] [ARROW]，目标是输出该 slot 当前绑定的 value。关键构造有三点。第一，训练流是无限的，document 内绑定重采样，value 在文档内不重复分配给不同 slot，因此任务不能靠参数记忆解决。第二，对被查询 slot，旧值 v_old 会出现 R_old 次，之后被新值 v_new 覆盖一次，且查询位于最后一次更新后 ΔD 个 statement 之后。这样在所有训练样本上，‘选最近一次赋值’与‘选最稀有值’恒等地指向同一个答案，因为当前值只出现一次，而旧值重复 R_old 次。第三，作者用最小因果编辑来读出机制：只翻转竞争 value 的出现次数，不改变 ground truth、总 token 数、答案位置和其余 token。若 log-odds 变化 Δ 为正，说明读出更跟随 rarity；若为负，则说明重复次数在推动模型偏向应被抑制的旧值。这个设计比普通 probe 更强，因为它不是在相关性上猜机制，而是在保持任务语义不变的前提下，直接测试模型对某个统计量的因果敏感性。

论文还分析了训练早期的另一种非检索机制：模型先学会从文档末尾固定 token offset 处复制 value。这个策略利用了 token 布局，而不是 slot 匹配与时间检索。其理论上限由 ΔD 支持集大小决定，即 1/|supp(ΔD)|。作者指出，如果在这一阶段直接用频次干预去读机制，会得到强负的 Δ，看起来像是一个‘频率型区域’，但其实模型连真正的 retrieval circuit 都还没形成。这一点很重要：机制 probe 必须结合训练阶段解释，否则很容易把前电路阶段的布局捷径误判成稳定规则。
summary.experiments: 实验主体是 26M 参数 transformer，在多个冗余度 R_old 配置上重复 75 次训练。核心结果有几组。第一，所有分析单元在 held-in evaluation 上都达到 acc≥0.999，包括作者专门挑出的、简单“最后一次更新就是答案”启发式失效的 strata；这说明单靠准确率完全无法区分内部机制。第二，在最小因果编辑下，不同 seed 学到的读出会明显分化：25 个 cell 中有 13 个 cell 在三种 seed 下的 sign fraction 差异超过 0.3，最大达到 0.879，而文档采样带来的标准误只有 0.025。这说明不稳定性不是测量噪声，而是机制本身未被目标函数唯一确定。第三，同一 run 内，机制形成后的不同 checkpoint 之间，读出标准差最高可达 0.303；把训练 schedule 加倍，也会推动这些‘数据统计无法预先区分’的 cell 迁移。相对地，关于“何时出现 retrieval”这一时间信号，在这些比较下是稳定的。第四，控制编辑只改非查询 slot，扰动同样数量 token，但影响保持在 0.015 nats 以内，支持该干预确实在读与查询机制相关的敏感性。第五，作者观察到 pooled over seeds 时，sign fraction 会随 R_old 单调上升，至少到 R_old=12 为止，说明冗余度会改变某类读出的倾向，但并不能把机制锁定成唯一形式。文中还解释了为何不使用 R_old=1 和 2：前者 rarity 无信息，后者在预算内 retrieval circuit 往往不形成；上界 16 则来自文档布局约束，避免重复块直接暴露 queried slot。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 和 Setup，弄清作者不是在比较哪条规则更好，而是在证明‘当训练目标对两条规则无差别时，机制归因不该被过度解释’。第二，看最小因果编辑的定义，以及 Δ 的符号如何对应 rarity-sensitive 与 repetition-sensitive 读出，这是全文最关键的测量工具。第三，看训练早期 fixed-offset copying 的分析，尤其是作者如何用理论 ceiling 1/|supp(ΔD)| 解释早期性能，这一段能帮助区分“先有捷径，后有检索”与“直接形成检索电路”两种训练动态。

如果时间有限，优先看：任务生成器定义、主结果图里 held-in accuracy 与 intervention readout 的反差、seed/checkpoint/schedule 三种不稳定性证据、以及控制编辑实验。预计 30-45 分钟能抓住主结论。若想深挖，重点看附录里对其他候选规则的可分离性分析，以及为什么 timing 信号稳定而具体机制不稳定。这篇文章更像一篇方法论提醒：做机制解释时，先问训练分布有没有把候选机制区分开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: when multiple corpus statistics are perfectly coextensive during training, what mechanism does a model actually learn, and can standard held-in evaluation tell them apart? The authors build a synthetic assignment language where the task is always to return the current value of a queried slot, while two candidate rules—retrieve the most recent assignment vs. pick the rarest value—are made exactly equivalent on every training example. The goal is not to improve task accuracy. It is to test whether mechanistic attribution is fundamentally underdetermined when the objective is indifferent among competing internal solutions, and to separate what the data distribution fixes from what it leaves free.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is methodological. The main result is that near-perfect in-distribution accuracy does not identify the learned mechanism when the training distribution never forces competing rules to disagree. What can be stable is the timing of capability formation; what need not be stable is the specific circuit that realizes it. This matters for interpreting LLM behavior under conflicting context, stale documents, repeated mentions, retrieval contamination, and similar settings where recency and frequency cues often align in natural corpora. It also matters for data-centric pretraining work: data distributions do not only shape performance, they also determine which mechanisms are identifiable at all. If the corpus makes two rules observationally indistinguishable, post hoc probes can easily overstate what has been learned.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is deliberately controlled. Each document is a sequence of assignment statements of the form [ent] [attr] [val] [SEP], followed by a query [QUERY] [ent] [attr] [ARROW]; the target is the value currently bound to that slot. Bindings are resampled per document from disjoint vocabularies, and the stream is infinite, so the task cannot be solved by memorizing weights. For the queried slot, an old value v_old is written and then repeated R_old times, later replaced by a new value v_new written once, and the query appears ΔD statements after the final update. Because the current value appears exactly once while the superseded value appears R_old times, “most recent” and “rarest” always select the same answer on training data.

To read out the mechanism, the authors introduce a minimal causal edit: they invert the multiplicities of the competing values while holding the ground truth, total token count, answer position, and all other tokens fixed. They then measure the signed change in answer log-odds, Δ. Positive Δ indicates sensitivity consistent with rarity; negative Δ indicates that repetition boosts the value that should be suppressed. This is stronger than a correlational probe because it directly tests causal sensitivity to one statistic while preserving task semantics.

A second technical contribution is the analysis of an early training shortcut. Before a retrieval circuit forms, models learn to copy a value from a fixed token offset near the end of the document. That strategy depends on layout regularities rather than slot matching plus temporal retrieval. Its accuracy ceiling is predicted by 1/|supp(ΔD)|, and the paper shows the models nearly saturate that ceiling when the support is narrow. Applying the intervention during this phase yields strongly negative Δ, which would look like a clean frequency-sensitive regime if one ignored training stage. The paper uses this to argue that mechanism readouts must be interpreted jointly with training dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use 26M-parameter transformers, with 75 total runs across redundancy settings. Several findings stand out. First, every analyzed cell reaches held-in accuracy of at least 0.999, including strata where the trivial heuristic “the last update is the answer” fails. So standard evaluation cannot distinguish opposite internal dependencies on repetition count. Second, under the causal edit, the same nominal configuration can separate sharply across seeds: in 13 of 25 cells, the sign fraction differs by more than 0.3 across three seeds, with the largest difference reaching 0.879, while the document-level standard error is only 0.025. That gap is too large to attribute to sampling noise. Third, within a single run, post-formation checkpoints can still vary substantially, with within-run standard deviation up to 0.303; doubling the training schedule also moves cells that the data distribution does not distinguish in advance. By contrast, the timing of retrieval formation remains stable across these comparisons. Fourth, a control edit on a non-queried slot changes the same number of tokens but stays within 0.015 nats, supporting the specificity of the intervention. Fifth, when pooled across seeds, sign fraction increases monotonically with redundancy level through at least R_old = 12, showing that redundancy changes the tendency of the readout without uniquely fixing the mechanism. The paper also explains why R_old = 1 and 2 are excluded and why 16 is the structural upper bound under the document layout constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the setup and the exact equivalence construction. The key point is not that one rule beats another, but that the objective is made exactly indifferent between them. Then focus on the minimal causal edit and the interpretation of the signed log-odds change Δ; that is the central measurement device. After that, read the section on the pre-retrieval fixed-offset copying phase. It is the part that prevents an overly simple reading of the intervention results and gives the paper its strongest training-dynamics insight.

If reading selectively, prioritize: the task generator, the main figure contrasting held-in accuracy with intervention-based separation, the seed/checkpoint/schedule instability evidence, and the control edit. That is enough to get the main message in about 30–45 minutes. For deeper study, the appendices on other candidate rules and the discussion of why timing is stable while mechanism identity is not are worth attention. The paper is best read as a cautionary note for mechanistic claims: before attributing a circuit to a corpus statistic, check whether the training distribution ever made the alternatives distinguishable.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验构造和 intervention 结果即可；它会降低你对“小模型合成任务 circuit 复现性”的信心。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and intervention results; it should make you less trusting of circuit claims from synthetic small-model tasks.

paper.title: Model of Models: When Does Emitting a Specialist Beat Attending, Adapting, or Tuning?
paper.abstract: Given a task described by a few examples, how should a model be specialized to it? Four mechanisms are available -- zero-shot, in-context attention, test-time gradient adaptation, and emitting specialist weights from a hypernetwork -- yet the operating regime of the last is rarely mapped. We run the identical four-way comparison across six tasks spanning regression, generation, language modeling, reinforcement learning, and clinical and genomic classification, holding the specialist, the context

summary.core_problem: 给定少样本任务描述时，模型究竟该靠上下文注意、测试时梯度适配，还是直接生成一个任务专用 specialist 权重。
summary.importance: 价值在于把四种 task specialization 机制放到同一比较框架里，试图回答 hypernetwork 式“发射专家”在什么 regime 下比 in-context 或 test-time adaptation 更合算。这更像元学习/条件建模问题，对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性一般，但对 test-time specialization 和 amortization 有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者做了统一四路对比：zero-shot、in-context attention、test-time gradient adaptation、以及由 hypernetwork 直接生成 specialist 权重。关键控制变量是尽量固定 specialist 结构、上下文和训练预算，从而比较不同 specialization 机制本身的成本—质量权衡，而不是让模型容量或训练资源混入结论。
summary.experiments: 覆盖六类任务：回归、生成、语言建模、强化学习、临床和基因组分类。摘要里较明确的结果包括：在临床 few-shot 分类上，emission 可打平 TabPFN，同时生成可复用 specialist，避免每次查询都重读 support set；在正弦回归上，零测试时梯度步数下比 MAML 低 2–3 个数量级；在 shape generation 上用 132 个 float 的 per-instance program 达到接近噪声下限。未见大规模 LLM 级别实验。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks how a model should specialize to a few-shot task: via in-context attention, test-time gradient adaptation, or by emitting task-specific specialist weights.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a controlled comparison of four specialization mechanisms, especially mapping the regime where hypernetwork-style specialist emission is preferable. This is more meta-learning than core LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to amortized adaptation and test-time specialization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares zero-shot inference, in-context attention, test-time gradient adaptation, and hypernetwork-based weight emission under a matched setup. The main methodological choice is to hold the specialist architecture, context, and training budget as fixed as possible so the comparison isolates the specialization mechanism itself.
summary_en.experiments: It spans six tasks: regression, generation, language modeling, reinforcement learning, and clinical/genomic classification. Reported highlights include matching TabPFN on clinical few-shot classification while emitting a reusable specialist, achieving near-noise-floor shape generation with a 132-float per-instance program, and beating MAML by 2–3 orders of magnitude on sinusoid regression at zero test-time gradient steps. No large-scale LLM experiments are indicated.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但“emit weights vs attend context”这个比较值得记住；先看设定是否真把容量和预算控干净，再决定要不要借到 test-time specialization。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the 'emit weights vs attend to context' comparison is worth caching; first check whether capacity and budget are actually controlled before borrowing any conclusion.

paper.title: Tydra: An Efficient Hybrid Model for Tabular Data
paper.abstract: Transformer-based tabular foundation models such as TabPFN achieve strong predictive performance but incur quadratic computational cost with context length. On the other hand, subquadratic SSM-based alternatives such as Hydra trade away accuracy for efficiency. To balance both, we introduce Tydra, a hybrid Transformer-State Space Model (SSM) architecture for tabular in-context learning that interleaves attention and SSM layers. Across 30 OpenML datasets, Tydra reduces inference time by 30% relat

summary.core_problem: 在表格 in-context learning 中同时获得注意力模型的精度与 SSM 的亚二次推理效率。
summary.importance: 混合 Attention+SSM 的一个具体落地案例；对 LLM 主干架构的启发主要在“交错堆叠”的工程权衡，而非新的语言建模结论。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tydra：在网络中交错插入 Transformer attention 层与 SSM（Hydra 风格）层，以降低随上下文长度增长的推理成本，同时尽量保留 TabPFN 的预测性能。
summary.experiments: 在 30 个 OpenML 表格数据集上：相对 TabPFN 推理时间降低约 30%，性能“保留大部分”；并且优于约 10 倍参数量的 Hydra 且更快（摘要未给出具体指标与方差）。

summary_en.core_problem: Achieve TabPFN-like accuracy while improving subquadratic inference efficiency for tabular in-context learning.
summary_en.importance: A concrete hybrid Attention+SSM design point; useful mainly as an engineering trade-off example rather than a new language modeling result.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tydra interleaves Transformer attention layers with SSM (Hydra-style) layers to reduce inference cost with context length while retaining much of TabPFN performance.
summary_en.experiments: Across 30 OpenML datasets: ~30% faster inference than TabPFN with most performance retained; also beats an ~10× larger Hydra while being faster (no detailed metrics in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把它当“Attention+SSM 交错堆叠”的表格版 sanity check：只需看架构图和速度/精度表，别期待对文本预训练有新结论。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a tabular sanity check for interleaving Attention and SSM; read the architecture and speed/accuracy table, not for new LM pretraining insights.

paper.title: Prompt-Model Interaction Reaches the Fixed Points: A deterministic, task-free structural readout -- and the factorizations of it that failed
paper.abstract: That a prompt's effect is not a property of the prompt is established: prompts optimised for one model degrade on another, and rankings reorder under neutral reformatting. That evidence is about task accuracy, which cannot say whether the interaction is a fact about task machinery or about the conditional distribution itself. We ask on a readout with no task in it: the fixed-point structure of the short-window argmax map x_{t+1} = argmax_x p(x | x_{t-1}, x_t), censused from 96 starts. It is dete

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章想回答的不是“哪个 prompt 在任务上更好”，而是更底层的问题：prompt 与 model 的相互作用，是否已经深入到模型条件分布本身，而不只是影响 instruction following、格式解析或答案抽取这类任务机制。作者为此避开任务评测，转而研究一个无任务、确定性的读出：短窗口 argmax 动力系统 xt+1 = argmax p(x | xt-1, xt) 的 fixed-point 结构。核心问题是，不同前缀是否会系统性改变这个 fixed-point 结构，而且这种改变是否能被简单地分解为 prefix 属性、model 属性或某种局部机制解释。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接帮助有限，但对理解“prompt 不是外部包装，而是会改写模型局部动力学”这件事有启发。它的价值主要在机制分析和评测方法上，而不是训练 recipe。文章试图把 prompt sensitivity 从任务精度层面下沉到 conditional distribution 层面，这一点是认真的：如果在没有任务、没有采样噪声、没有 verbalizer 的条件下，prefix 仍能显著改变固定点结构，那么 prompt-model interaction 至少部分是模型内部生成动力学的性质，而不是 benchmark artifact。这个结论对做 tokenizer、prefix tuning、context engineering、ICL 机制分析的人有参考意义，但离 pretrain 主线较远，属于可了解但不必深挖的工作。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者构造了一个确定性的短窗口迭代探针。给定最近两个 token，模型输出下一个 token 的 argmax，再把窗口向前滚动，形成离散动力系统；从 96 个随机 two-token starts 出发，统计轨迹最终是否落入 fixed point，并据此定义 fixed-point fraction φ。除了 φ，作者还把轨迹结构分成 funnel、none、fragmented、borderline 等类别，用来描述吸引子几何。关键设计是把 prefix 作为 wrapper 加到每次前向输入前，而不改变估计器本身，从而把观测到的变化归因于条件分布而不是读出定义。实验比较了 raw、bos、普通文本等多种 prefix，并在 6 个模型上做 window sweep。文章的主张不是提出一个成功解释，而是系统展示一系列解释为什么失败：prefix 长度不是单调因素；prefix 内容的两个候选因子在扩大样本后失效；模型侧的 universal direction、bidirectionality、instruct-resistance 等假设也失效；连 attention sink strength 这种较接近机制层的解释，在 5 个模型里也只在 2 个上和 fixed-point shift 同号。最后留下的不是一个整洁因子，而是 pairwise、model-conditioned 的相互作用：同一个 prefix 可以把四个模型推向 0、把两个模型推向 1。
summary.experiments: 实验主结果集中在 fixed-point fraction 和结构类别变化。作者声称仅 9 个 token 的 prefix 就能让 fixed-point fraction 跨越其大部分取值范围，并改变四分类结构；而 instruction tuning 虽然在 matched pair 上带来 +60.5 IFEval 分数提升，却没有改变 fixed-point class。另一个关键结果是窗口长度敏感性：这种 fixed-point 结构只存在于短窗口，6 个模型里有 4 个在窗口变大后完全失去该结构。作者还做了 prefix-side、model-side、mechanistic 三层因子检验，但都没有在样本扩大后站住。特别是 attention-sink strength 与 fixed-point shift 的一致性只有 2/5，作者把它视为接近随机。整体上，这些实验更像一组负结果加一个稳健现象：prefix 对短窗口条件分布动力学的影响很大，但简单解释不成立。由于论文关注的是结构读出而非任务指标，数字不多，重点在现象的选择性和解释失败的边界。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点不是接受作者所有结论，而是看他们如何构造一个尽量去任务化的 prompt interaction probe。建议先读 Introduction，明确作者为什么拒绝用 accuracy 讨论 prompt 效应。然后看 Setup，弄清 fixed-point fraction、四类结构、96 个起点、window sweep 分别在测什么。结果部分优先看 §3 到 §6：先看“现象有多大”，再看 prefix-side、model-side、mechanistic 三类解释如何逐一失败。阅读时要保持一点保留：这个探针是很人工的短窗口 argmax 动力系统，外推到真实长上下文生成要谨慎。预计 35 分钟左右可以读完主线。值得留意的点是，作者强调 instruction tuning 对这个读出几乎不动，而短 prefix 却能强烈改变结构，这对“后训练改了什么、没改什么”提供了一个有趣但尚不成熟的观察角度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more basic question than prompt effectiveness on tasks: does prompt-model interaction live inside the model’s conditional distribution itself, rather than only in task machinery such as instruction following, formatting, or answer extraction? To avoid task confounds, the authors study a task-free deterministic readout: the fixed-point structure of the short-window argmax dynamical system x_{t+1} = argmax_x p(x | x_{t-1}, x_t). The core problem is whether prefixes systematically alter this fixed-point structure, and whether that effect can be explained by simple prefix-side factors, model-side factors, or a nearby mechanistic account.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, and its direct impact on training recipes is limited. Its value is more conceptual: it pushes prompt sensitivity below benchmark accuracy and into the geometry of the conditional distribution. If a prefix changes fixed-point structure even when there is no task, no sampling noise, and no verbalizer, then at least part of prompt-model interaction is a property of the model’s internal generation dynamics rather than a benchmark artifact. That is relevant to people studying in-context learning, prefix effects, tokenizer/context interfaces, and mechanistic interpretability. For core pretraining work, it is peripheral but intellectually useful.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a deterministic short-window probe. Starting from the last two tokens, the model predicts the next token by argmax; the window is rolled forward and the process is iterated, producing a discrete dynamical system. From 96 random two-token starts, the authors measure the fixed-point fraction φ, the proportion of trajectories that terminate in a fixed point. They also classify trajectory geometry into funnel, none, fragmented, and borderline, which gives a coarse structural summary of the attractor landscape. Prefixes are added as wrappers to every forward pass without changing the estimator, so the observed effect is attributed to the conditional distribution rather than to the readout definition. The paper compares raw, BOS, and ordinary text prefixes across six models and sweeps window size. The interesting part is that the paper is organized around failed factorizations. Prefix length is not a monotone driver. Two proposed content-side factors fail after widening the sample. Model-side hypotheses such as a universal direction, bidirectionality as a model property, and instruct-resistance also fail. Even the nearest mechanistic account, attention-sink strength, matches the sign of the fixed-point shift in only 2 of 5 models. What remains is pairwise and model-conditioned: the same prefix can push four models toward 0 and two toward 1.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical results are about changes in fixed-point fraction and structural class. The authors report that a nine-token prefix can move the fixed-point fraction across most of its range and can change the four-way structural class, while instruction tuning, despite yielding +60.5 IFEval points on a matched pair, changes the fixed-point class by zero. Another key result is the dependence on window size: the fixed-point structure exists only at short windows, and four of six models lose it entirely as the window grows. The paper then tests prefix-side, model-side, and mechanistic explanations, but none survives sample widening. In particular, attention-sink strength agrees in sign with the fixed-point shift for only 2/5 models, which the authors treat as chance-level support. Overall, the experiments read as one robust phenomenon plus a sequence of negative results: prefixes strongly affect short-window conditional dynamics, but the obvious explanatory decompositions do not hold up.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim read. Start with the introduction to see why the authors reject task accuracy as the right lens for prompt interaction. Then read the setup carefully: fixed-point fraction, the four structural classes, the 96-start census, and the window sweep are the core of the paper. In the results, prioritize Sections 3 through 6. First understand the size and selectivity of the effect, then see how the prefix-side, model-side, and mechanistic explanations fail one by one. Read with some caution: this is a highly artificial short-window argmax probe, so extrapolation to normal long-context generation should be conservative. Around 30-40 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. The most interesting takeaway is the asymmetry between short prefixes and instruction tuning: the former can strongly alter this readout, while the latter barely moves it, which may hint at what post-training changes and what it leaves untouched.

recommendation.zh: 视角很刁钻，剥离了具体任务，纯看短窗口的 argmax 动态，发现指令微调不改变底层的读取结构，值得一看实验设计。
recommendation.en: A very unique perspective that strips away specific tasks to purely observe short-window argmax dynamics, finding that instruction tuning doesn't change the underlying readout structure; the experimental design is worth a look.

paper.title: RecPFN: Prior-Fitted Networks for In-Context-Based Recommendations
paper.abstract: We introduce RecPFN, a prior-fitted network that brings in-context learning to sequential recommendation. RecPFN is pretrained entirely on synthetic clickstream environments sampled from a broad structural causal prior, enabling it to amortize Bayesian-style inference from a small support set. At inference, a lightweight decoder-only transformer conditions on a handful of domain sequences and produces next-item predictions for queries in a single forward pass, without any weight updates. Across

summary.core_problem: 如何利用在合成数据上预训练的 Transformer 模型，通过上下文学习 (ICL) 实现零样本的序列推荐。
summary.importance: 将 Prior-Fitted Networks (PFN) 的概念引入推荐系统，展示了仅在合成因果先验数据上预训练的模型，能在真实推荐场景中展现出强大的 ICL 能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RecPFN，完全在从广泛结构因果先验中采样的合成点击流环境上进行预训练。推理时，一个轻量级仅解码器 Transformer 接收少量领域序列作为上下文，通过单次前向传播进行预测，无需权重更新。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个公开基准上，RecPFN 实现了 SOTA 的零样本性能，并在低计算/低数据场景下与监督方法具有竞争力。它对领域偏移具有鲁棒性，优于依赖大规模真实交互语料的零样本基线。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve zero-shot sequential recommendation via in-context learning (ICL) using a Transformer model pretrained on synthetic data.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the concept of Prior-Fitted Networks (PFN) to recommendation systems, demonstrating that models pretrained solely on synthetic causal prior data can exhibit strong ICL capabilities in real-world recommendation scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes RecPFN, pretrained entirely on synthetic clickstream environments sampled from a broad structural causal prior. During inference, a lightweight decoder-only Transformer conditions on a few domain sequences and predicts via a single forward pass without weight updates.
summary_en.experiments: On 8 public benchmarks, RecPFN achieves SOTA zero-shot performance and is competitive with supervised methods in low-compute/low-data regimes. It is robust to domain shift and outperforms zero-shot baselines relying on large real-interaction corpora.

recommendation.zh: 将 PFN (Prior-Fitted Networks) 思想应用于推荐系统，展示了合成数据预训练带来的泛化能力，对关注 ICL 机制和合成数据预训练的研究员有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Applies PFN (Prior-Fitted Networks) to recommendation systems, demonstrating generalization from synthetic data pretraining; offers insights for researchers interested in ICL mechanisms and synthetic data pretraining.

paper.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Structure-Aware Numerical Reasoning in LLaMA 3.1 8B
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong numerical sequence modeling capabilities and show promise in time-series prediction. While LLMs display in-context learning capabilities, the mechanisms with which they accomplish time-series prediction remain unclear. Specifically, whether they truly understand the underlying structure, which at a minimum requires reasoning over first differences in the sequence of numbers. To study this, we investigate Llama 3.1-8B from a m

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLaMA 3.1 8B 在数值序列和类时间序列预测中，是否真的利用了一阶差分等结构线索，而不是只做表面模式匹配。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。LLM 的数值序列建模和时间序列 in-context learning 常被报告为有效，但内部算法不清楚；这类工作试图把能力拆到可干预的表示和计算路径上。对预训练研究员的价值在于理解模型是否从 next-token 训练中学到可泛化的结构操作。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造一个必须识别结构线索才能解决的序列任务：采样若干随机数字，并以固定 offset 重复，要求模型利用序列的一阶差分或重复偏移关系。随后以 mechanistic interpretability 方法研究 LLaMA 3.1 8B 的内部行为，可能包括激活分析、patching、attention/head 或 MLP 组件定位等，但摘要未披露完整技术细节。
summary.experiments: 实验对象明确为 LLaMA 3.1 8B。任务是作者构造的结构感知数值序列建模任务。摘要未给出样本规模、对照模型、消融设置或准确率提升；因此当前只能判断研究问题相关，不能判断结论强度。
summary.authors_note: David Bau 是 mechanistic interpretability 和模型编辑方向的知名研究者。其他机构信息无法从给定内容中确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLaMA 3.1 8B performs numerical sequence prediction by using structural cues such as first differences, rather than relying on shallow pattern matching.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. LLMs are increasingly reported to perform numerical sequence modeling and time-series-style in-context learning, but the internal algorithm is unclear. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is whether next-token training induces reusable structural operations over numbers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct a sequence modeling task that cannot be solved without detecting structure: random numbers are sampled and then repeated with an offset, forcing the model to reason over first differences or offset-based repetition. They then analyze LLaMA 3.1 8B using mechanistic interpretability tools, likely including activation-level interventions and component localization, though the abstract does not expose the full method details.
summary_en.experiments: The analyzed model is LLaMA 3.1 8B. The main task is a synthetic structure-aware numerical sequence task. The abstract does not report dataset size, baselines, ablations, or accuracy numbers, so the strength of the empirical claim cannot be judged from the provided text.
summary_en.authors_note: David Bau is a well-known researcher in mechanistic interpretability and model editing. Institutional details cannot be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 问题选得对，但摘要看不到干预结果；只看任务构造和关键 patching 图，别把数值推理结论外推太远。
recommendation.en: The question is well chosen, but the intervention evidence is unclear here; read the task setup and main patching figures only.

paper.title: Understanding the Surprising Generalization Properties of Tabular Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) increasingly rely on in-context learning, where a model receives labelled examples at inference time and predicts labels for new inputs without updating its weights. Existing TFMs are typically trained on either massive synthetic corpora or very large collections of real datasets. In contrast, we show that surprisingly strong transfer can emerge from self-supervised pre-training on just a single real table. In this setting, we also find that tables tend to be eit

summary.core_problem: 研究 tabular foundation models 的 in-context generalization 从何而来，尤其是为什么少量甚至单个真实表的自监督预训练也能产生较强迁移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和数据设计信号。虽然对象是表格模型，不是文本 LLM，但它把预训练收益解释为“任务数量和任务质量”的函数，而不是简单的数据行数函数；这一点对思考 LM 预训练中的 task diversity、schema diversity 和数据清洗有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文对单表自监督预训练、不同表作为预训练源的可迁移性、表级属性与下游表现之间的关系做系统分析，并提出 task-centric interpretation。它还把该视角用于大规模语料设计，考察细粒度 column-level preprocessing 对下游表现的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要称仅在一个真实表上做自监督预训练即可出现强迁移；不同表通常表现为“普遍有用”或“普遍较差”，且 usefulness 的最强预测因子是 feature 数而非 instance 数。大规模语料实验中，细粒度列级预处理能稳定改善下游预测。给定摘要未提供模型规模、数据集数量、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Frank Hutter 是 AutoML 和 tabular learning 方向知名研究者；给定信息未提供完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper investigates why tabular foundation models can generalize in context, including the surprising case where self-supervised pretraining on a single real table transfers well.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and corpus-design analysis. Although it targets tabular foundation models rather than text LMs, its task-centric framing—task number and task quality matter more than raw row count—has indirect value for thinking about pretraining data diversity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze transfer from self-supervised pretraining on individual tables, relate table-level properties to downstream utility, and propose a task-centric interpretation of tabular pretraining. They also apply the idea to corpus design at scale, including fine-grained column-level preprocessing.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports strong transfer after pretraining on just one real table. Tables tend to be broadly useful or broadly poor across downstream tasks, and feature count is a stronger predictor of usefulness than instance count. At corpus scale, fine-grained column preprocessing consistently improves downstream performance. The supplied abstract does not include model sizes, exact baselines, or gain magnitudes.
summary_en.authors_note: Frank Hutter is a well-known researcher in AutoML and tabular learning; full institutional details are not available from the supplied metadata.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 的两个数据设计信号即可；TFM 结论不能直接搬到文本 LM。
recommendation.en: Read the two corpus-design signals in the abstract; do not directly port the TFM conclusion to text LMs.

paper.title: Semantic Bandits: In-Context Exploration-Exploitation is Biased by Semantic Priors
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-making agents in settings that require sophisticated environmental exploration. However, existing work has raised questions about how LLMs actually balance exploration and exploitation. Unlike classical agents, LLM agents engage with tasks through natural language, exposing them to semantic information with no formal counterpart in the task structure. We introduce the semantic bandit, an extension of the multi-armed bandit settin

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 在 in-context bandit 决策里，探索—利用行为是否被动作文本标签和奖励语义先验系统性扭曲，而不是仅由形式化 reward structure 决定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在 bandit 方法本身，而在于它把一种典型的预训练遗留偏置讲得更清楚：模型在决策时并不是在抽象符号空间里更新策略，而是在自然语言表征上调用预训练中学到的语义联想。动作命名、奖励正负号、场景措辞都可能成为隐式先验。这对研究 RL-as-in-context learning、agent pretraining 接口、以及训练后对齐时的 prompt/rendering 敏感性都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 semantic bandit，把经典 multi-armed bandit 扩展为同时参数化形式任务结构与文本呈现方式的环境。核心变量包括：动作 nomenclature，也就是每个 arm 的自然语言标签；奖励极性与数值表达；以及场景文本。借这个框架，作者比较语义标签与真实 reward 分布对齐、错配或中性的情况，观察 LLM 是否会在极少探索下直接利用语义先验，或者被错误先验带偏。论文的贡献主要是评测设定和行为分析，而不是新的学习算法。
summary.experiments: 主要发现有三点。第一，动作标签显著影响探索行为：当高奖励 arm 配上正向语义标签时，模型会更快利用、累计 regret 更低；当标签与真实奖励错配时，同样的先验会把模型引向低奖励动作，regret 明显上升。第二，奖励极性本身是强上下文信号：负奖励会触发更多探索，说明模型并非把 reward 当作纯抽象数值，而是相对某种语义预期来解释。第三，这两类偏置会交互：在负奖励条件下，模型更不容易盲目依赖动作标签的语义先验。就研究深度看，这些结果更像对 ICRL 行为偏差的系统刻画，而不是对预训练机制的直接干预。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。先看 introduction 和 problem definition，理解作者为何认为经典 bandit 评测漏掉了语言表征这一变量；再看主实验图，重点关注 aligned / misaligned nomenclature 与 reward polarity 的对比。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要结论。如果关心 pretrain→agent 的接口，可以多看 discussion，思考这些偏置是 prompt artifact，还是预训练语义统计在决策中的稳定外显。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether exploration–exploitation behavior in in-context bandit tasks is systematically biased by semantic priors from pretraining, rather than being driven only by the formal reward structure.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but real. The paper makes a useful point: LLM agents do not act in a stripped symbolic state space. They act through natural-language renderings, so pretrained associations about action names, reward wording, and scenario framing can shape decision behavior. That is relevant for in-context RL, agent evaluation, and the broader pretrain-to-posttrain interface, especially when prompt format or environment rendering changes behavior in ways classical RL abstractions would miss.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the semantic bandit, an extension of the standard multi-armed bandit that explicitly models not only the reward distributions but also the textual representation of actions and rewards. The main manipulated factors are action nomenclature, reward polarity, and scenario wording. They then compare settings where semantic labels are aligned with the true reward structure, misaligned with it, or neutral, and measure how LLMs explore and exploit under these different renderings. The contribution is primarily an evaluation framework plus behavioral analysis, not a new learning method.
summary_en.experiments: The main findings are straightforward. First, action labels strongly affect exploration: when high-reward arms receive semantically favorable names, models exploit quickly and incur lower regret; when the labels are misleading, the same priors push models toward worse arms and regret rises sharply. Second, reward polarity matters: negative rewards induce substantially more exploration than positive rewards, suggesting that models interpret rewards relative to semantic expectations rather than as purely abstract numbers. Third, these effects interact: under negative rewards, models rely less on semantic action-label priors. The paper is more about characterizing a failure mode in ICRL behavior than about intervening on pretraining itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough. Read the introduction and problem definition to see why the authors think classical bandit formulations miss an important variable for LLM agents. Then inspect the main figures comparing aligned versus misaligned nomenclature and positive versus negative reward settings. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the core message. If you care about the pretrain-to-agent interface, the discussion section is the part worth lingering on.

recommendation.zh: 语义先验会系统性扭曲 LLM agent 的 bandit 探索，这对 agent 训练中动作命名、工具接口设计有直接启发，重点读 §3 设定与 §4 对齐/错位对比。
recommendation.en: Semantic priors systematically distort bandit-style exploration in LLM agents, with direct implications for action naming and tool-interface design in agent training; focus on §3 setup and §4 aligned/misaligned comparisons.

paper.title: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries
paper.abstract: This study investigates the methodological and theoretical properties of session handover in applications that use large language models. A task may continue in a new session when the context reaches the model's input limit, when the application restarts, or when another agent is asked to finish the task. The application must then decide which information from the earlier session to pass on. We formulate handover as the transfer of a task-relative in-context learning (ICL) state and distinguish

summary.core_problem: 当LLM应用因上下文长度限制、应用重启或跨智能体协作需要开启新会话时，如何确定旧会话中哪些信息必须传递，才能保证新会话的预测与决策质量与完整上下文下一致，并量化所需的存储开销。
summary.importance: 会话交接的理论框架将上下文学习视为可编码的状态，为分析ICL的信息保留机制提供了形式化工具，也为长上下文模型设计、上下文压缩算法、智能体系统记忆模块的构建提供了可量化的理论基准。
summary.technical_approach: 将会话交接形式化为「查询前状态编码问题」，与已知查询的提示压缩有本质区别。框架分离四个独立组件：生成交接记录的writer、交接记录本身、续接流程、任务得分。引入统计充分性、贝叶斯决策论、信源编码等工具：在外生性条件下，预测等价性刻画了最粗粒度的确定性充分交接，给出固定长度比特需求；将性能损失分解为记忆约束导致的容量损失、writer选择导致的损失、以及续接流程与理想解码器的差距；在对数损失下，丢弃的任务信息严格等价于条件互信息。论文还在高斯线性回归和非参数回归两个设定下，推导了具体的充分记录构造和记忆-风险权衡关系。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论性工作，无大规模实证实验。核心结果通过解析推导得到：高斯线性回归设定下存在精确的有限维充分记录，可等价表示为合成的充分示例，并能给出后验预测的有限比特扰动界；非参数回归设定下给出了可达到的记忆-风险关系，以及平方损失任务的样本量和记忆下界。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看引言的问题定义和四个核心贡献，再看会话交接概述章节的核心概念区分（交接记录与KV缓存、外部记录的区别，交接与提示压缩的区别）。重点理解预测充分性框架和损失分解的三层结构。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When an LLM application needs to start a new session due to context length limits, application restarts, or cross-agent handoff, how to determine which information from the previous session must be passed on to preserve prediction and decision quality matching the full context, and how to quantify the required storage overhead.
summary_en.importance: The theoretical framework of session handover treats in-context learning as an encodable state, providing formal tools to analyze information retention in ICL. It also offers quantifiable theoretical baselines for long-context model design, context compression algorithms, and memory module construction in agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Session handover is formulated as a pre-query state coding problem, fundamentally distinct from query-aware prompt compression. The framework separates four independent components: the writer that produces the handover record, the record itself, the continuation procedure, and the task score. Using tools from statistical sufficiency, Bayesian decision theory, and source coding: under an exogeneity condition, predictive equivalence characterizes the coarsest deterministic sufficient handover and gives a fixed-length bit requirement. Performance loss is decomposed into three parts: capacity loss from memory constraints, loss from writer choice, and the gap between the continuation procedure and the ideal decoder. Under log loss, discarded task information is exactly equivalent to conditional mutual information. The paper also derives concrete sufficient record constructions and memory-risk tradeoffs for two settings: Gaussian linear regression and nonparametric regression.
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical work with no large-scale empirical experiments. Core results are derived analytically: in the Gaussian linear regression setting, an exact finite-dimensional sufficient record exists, can be equivalently represented as synthetic sufficient demonstrations, and admits finite-bit perturbation bounds for posterior prediction. In the nonparametric regression setting, the paper gives achievable memory-risk relations and sample-size / memory lower bounds for squared-loss tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, start with the introduction for problem definition and four core contributions, then move to the Overview of Session Handover section for key concept distinctions (handover record vs KV cache vs external records, handover vs prompt compression). Focus on the predictive sufficiency framework and the three-layer loss decomposition. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对长上下文管理和多 Agent 协作中的状态传递进行了理论形式化，对理解 ICL 状态的本质和设计更高效的 Context 压缩/传递机制有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Theoretically formalizes state transfer in long-context management and multi-agent collaboration, providing some inspiration for understanding the nature of ICL states and designing more efficient context compression/transfer mechanisms.

paper.title: Identifiability and Order-Dimension Limits of In-Context Learning on Partial Orders
paper.abstract: In-context learning is commonly formalized as inference from examples of a function. Partial orders instead combine transitivity, antisymmetry, and incomparability, so a finite prompt may not determine a queried comparison. We develop a theory of in-context learning on partial orders that separates logical identifiability, prompt teaching cost, structural complexity, and the exact capacity of a formal coordinate-decoder class. A version-space semantics makes background knowledge and open- versus

summary.core_problem: 研究偏序关系场景下上下文学习（ICL）的可识别性边界和阶维数限制，解决传统ICL函数形式化无法适配偏序不可比性的问题
summary.importance: 将ICL的理论分析从函数类扩展到偏序结构，给出可识别性的形式化刻画
summary.technical_approach: 采用版本空间语义显式建模背景知识和开放/封闭世界假设，将ICL能力拆解为逻辑可识别性、prompt教学代价、结构复杂度、解码器容量四个维度；证明有限开放世界prompt下的查询结果三分法定理，刻画开放世界教学数
summary.experiments: 纯理论工作，无真实大模型实证验证，所有结论基于形式化推导

summary_en.core_problem: Studies identifiability and order-dimension limits of in-context learning (ICL) on partial orders, addressing the mismatch between traditional function-based ICL formalization and the incomparability property of partial orders
summary_en.importance: Extends ICL theoretical analysis from function classes to partial order structures, providing formal characterizations of identifiability
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses version-space semantics to explicitly model background knowledge and open/closed world assumptions, decomposing ICL capability into logical identifiability, prompt teaching cost, structural complexity, and decoder capacity; proves a trichotomy theorem for query outcomes under finite open-world prompts, and characterizes open-world teaching number
summary_en.experiments: Pure theoretical work with no empirical validation on real LLMs; all conclusions are derived from formal proofs

recommendation.zh: 偏序场景下ICL可识别性的纯理论分析，无真实LLM实证支撑，结论偏抽象，作为文献备查即可
recommendation.en: Pure theoretical analysis of ICL identifiability on partial orders without LLM empirical validation; abstract conclusions, keep as literature reference only.

paper.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: We introduce BDH-CQ, a reasoning model that combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning. Inputs presented at inference time continuously update the model's recurrent memory; the model then solves a query through iterative computation in a high-dimensional latent space, without verbalizing its intermediate reasoning. We evaluate the model on the public ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set and use controlled ARC-like interventions to study what it learns from demonstrations, how consistently

summary.core_problem: 如何在不依赖显式中间推理步骤（verbalization）的情况下，提升模型在 ARC-AGI 任务上的推理能力和成本效率？
summary.importance: 提出了一种结合上下文学习和循环潜在推理的新架构 BDH-CQ，在 ARC-AGI-1 基准上实现了新的成本-准确率帕累托前沿，证明了潜在空间推理的有效性。
summary.technical_approach: 模型在推理时通过输入不断更新循环记忆，然后在高维潜在空间中通过迭代计算解决查询，而不输出中间的文本推理过程（verbalization）。
summary.experiments: 150M 参数配置在 ARC-AGI-1 评估集上达到 29.5% pass@2，单任务推理成本仅为 $0.0007，打破了之前的成本-准确率帕累托前沿。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自多个机构，关注高效推理和潜在空间模型。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve reasoning capability and cost-efficiency on ARC-AGI tasks without relying on explicit intermediate reasoning steps (verbalization)?
summary_en.importance: Proposes BDH-CQ, a novel architecture combining in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning, achieving a new cost-accuracy Pareto frontier on the ARC-AGI-1 benchmark and demonstrating the effectiveness of latent space reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model continuously updates its recurrent memory with inputs at inference time, then solves queries through iterative computation in a high-dimensional latent space, without verbalizing intermediate reasoning steps.
summary_en.experiments: A 150M-parameter configuration reaches 29.5% pass@2 on the ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set with an inference cost of $0.0007 per task, breaking the previous cost-accuracy Pareto frontier.
summary_en.authors_note: The author team is from multiple institutions, focusing on efficient reasoning and latent space models.

recommendation.zh: 探索了不依赖文本输出的潜在空间循环推理（Latent Reasoning），在 ARC 任务上取得了极高的成本效率，对研究 next-token 之外的推理范式很有启发。
recommendation.en: Explores latent space recurrent reasoning without text verbalization, achieving high cost-efficiency on ARC tasks, highly inspiring for researching reasoning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.

paper.title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
paper.abstract: Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five representative domains, each containing 100 interconnected subtasks ordered by increasing difficult

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM agent多依赖外部技能库提升任务表现，但缺乏系统的评测框架来验证agent能否在连续任务交互中自主合成、演化可复用技能，也无法确认演化出的技能是否真正带来能力提升。现有agent评测多基于孤立任务和固定技能文档，无法捕捉持续技能学习的动态过程。
summary.importance: ContinualSkillBench明确了当前agent将交互经验沉淀为可迁移技能的能力边界，为面向agent的预训练、持续预训练研究中，评估模型的上下文内技能抽象与复用能力提供了标准化参照。
summary.technical_approach: ContinualSkillBench是面向上下文内持续技能学习的动态评测框架，覆盖医疗、法律、数学、金融、办公5个代表性领域，每个领域包含100个存在依赖关系的子任务，锚定3个核心技能，按难度递增和技能复用机会递增的顺序排列。评测对比三类agent设置：顺序执行模式（每完成一个子任务就用反馈更新技能库，后续任务可调用更新后的技能）、独立基线模式（每个任务从零开始执行）、上下文学习模式（不显式维护技能库，仅依赖之前的交互上下文）。评测指标包括归一化奖励，以及技能数量、复用率、质量等维度。
summary.experiments: 在15组模型-领域组合中，顺序执行模式有14组优于独立基线，整体相对提升16.9%，但提升幅度在不同模型和领域间差异较大。在3个领域的消融实验中，上下文学习的平均归一化奖励为0.605，显式技能维护为0.602，两者表现相当，说明大部分性能提升来自对先前上下文和反馈的适应，而非可复用的技能抽象；显式技能仅在需要可复用流程或精确输出的任务上有选择性优势。不同模型的技能库行为差异显著：GPT-4o在5个领域共积累384个技能，GPT-5.3-Codex为205个，但GPT-4o的技能复用率更低、质量得分更差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点看第2节的benchmark设计逻辑，包括任务分层、排序规则；以及第4节的核心实验结果，尤其是显式技能维护与上下文学习的对比消融。各领域的具体任务细节可跳过。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern LLM agents rely on external skill libraries to boost task performance, but there is no systematic evaluation framework to verify whether agents can autonomously synthesize and evolve reusable skills during sequential task interactions, nor whether evolved skills lead to genuine capability improvements. Existing agent evaluations are mostly built on isolated tasks and fixed skill documents, which cannot capture the dynamics of continual skill learning.
summary_en.importance: ContinualSkillBench clarifies the capability limits of current agents at consolidating interaction experience into transferable skills. It provides a standardized reference for evaluating in-context skill abstraction and reuse in research on agent-oriented pretraining and continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ContinualSkillBench is a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers 5 representative domains: healthcare, law, mathematics, finance, and office. Each domain contains 100 interdependent subtasks anchored to 3 core skills, ordered by increasing difficulty and increasing opportunities for skill reuse. The framework compares three agent setups: sequential execution (updating a skill repository with feedback after each subtask, with subsequent tasks accessing the updated repository), independent baseline (solving each task from scratch), and in-context learning (no explicit skill repository, only prior interaction context as reference). Evaluation metrics include normalized reward, plus skill count, reuse rate, and quality.
summary_en.experiments: Sequential execution outperforms the independent baseline in 14 of 15 model-domain pairs, with an aggregate relative gain of 16.9%, though the magnitude of gains varies widely across models and domains. Ablation across 3 domains shows in-context learning achieves an average normalized reward of 0.605, compared to 0.602 for explicit skill maintenance — the two are comparable on average, indicating most performance gains come from adaptation to prior context and feedback rather than reusable skill abstraction. Explicit skills only deliver selective advantages on tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. Skill repository behavior differs substantially across models: GPT-4o accumulates 384 skills across 5 domains, versus 205 for GPT-5.3-Codex, but GPT-4o's skills have lower reuse rates and worse quality scores.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2 for the benchmark design logic, including task tiering and ordering criteria, and Section 4 for core experimental results, especially the ablation comparing explicit skill maintenance and in-context learning. Detailed task specifications per domain can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看实验分解，尤其 ICL≈skill maintenance；这会校正对 agent 技能库“持续学习”的过强假设。
recommendation.en: Read the ablations, especially ICL ≈ skill maintenance; it usefully tempers claims about agent skill-library learning.

institutions: Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University
Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence

paper.title: In-Context Collapse in Vision-Language Models and How to Mitigate it?
paper.abstract: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) lets vision-language models (VLMs) adapt from image--label demonstrations without weight updates, and is widely assumed to improve as more demonstrations are supplied. We show the opposite: as demonstrations accumulate, a subset of VLMs undergo an \emph{in-context collapse}, a sharp, sometimes catastrophic accuracy drop spanning synthetic classification, natural-image classification, and VQA benchmarks, in some models falling below chance while outputs remain

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型在多示例上下文学习时，示例数量增加并不会带来性能单调提升，反而会出现准确率骤降甚至低于随机猜测的上下文崩溃现象，现有研究未定位其底层机制，也未提出通用修复方案。
summary.importance: 揭示了VLM多模态ICL的一个关键失效模式，通过因果实验将问题锁定在视觉-语言连接通路而非语言模型深层，给出的轻量化、可迁移修复方案对多模态预训练阶段的视觉-语言连接器设计、训练目标设计有明确启发，解释了长期以来VLM长上下文多示例适配效果远差于纯文本LLM的原因。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过无预训练污染的合成概念任务（答案无法从预训练记忆中检索，必须从上下文学习），将VLM的ICL能力拆分为两个可分离的维度：对示例数量增加的鲁棒性、从上下文中学习新规则的能力。之后通过参数匹配的损伤-救援实验，因果定位崩溃来源为视觉-语言集成通路（连接器和语言模型早中层），而非后期读出层。最后提出CircA方法，仅需在一个合成任务上一次性训练一个小型适配模块，即可将崩溃抗性迁移到未见的任务族，无需针对下游任务微调。
summary.experiments: 在0.5B到11B参数规模的多个开源VLM（覆盖不同连接器设计）以及闭源前沿模型Claude Sonnet上均观测到上下文崩溃现象：例如Qwen2-VL-2B在CIFAR四分类任务上0样本准确率为94%，64个示例时准确率降至38%；LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B在相同设置下准确率降至低于25%的随机猜测水平。提出的CircA适配模块可以消除崩溃现象，同时恢复模型从上下文学习新规则的能力，效果可跨任务族迁移。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注上下文崩溃的现象刻画、因果定位的损伤-救援实验逻辑，无需细读修复方法的实现细节。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Unlike text LLMs where in-context learning (ICL) performance generally improves with more demonstrations, vision-language models often suffer sharp, sometimes catastrophic accuracy drops as in-context examples accumulate, even falling below random chance. Prior work has not localized the underlying mechanism or proposed a general mitigation for this phenomenon, termed in-context collapse.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a critical failure mode of multimodal ICL in VLMs, and causally localizes the issue to the vision-language integration pathway rather than deep language model layers. The proposed lightweight, transferable mitigation provides clear insights for VLM pretraining, particularly for vision-language connector design and training objective design, and explains the persistent performance gap between VLMs and pure text LLMs on many-shot in-context adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the authors decompose VLM ICL capability into two separable axes using contamination-free synthetic concept tasks (where answers cannot be retrieved from pretraining memory and must be learned from context): robustness to increasing demonstration count, and ability to learn novel rules from in-context examples. Second, parameter-matched lesion-and-rescue experiments causally locate in-context collapse to the vision-language integration pathway (the connector and early/mid layers of the language model), rather than late readout layers. Third, they propose CircA, a method that trains a small adapter once on a single synthetic task that transfers collapse resistance to unseen task families without downstream fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: In-context collapse is observed across open VLMs ranging from 0.5B to 11B parameters with varying connector designs, as well as the frontier closed model Claude Sonnet. For example, Qwen2-VL-2B achieves 94% accuracy on 4-way CIFAR classification with zero demonstrations, but accuracy drops to 38% at 64 shots; LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B drops below the 25% random chance baseline under the same setting. The CircA adapter eliminates collapse and restores in-context novel rule learning, with benefits transferring across unseen task families.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the behavioral characterization of in-context collapse and the causal lesion-and-rescue experimental design for failure localization. There is no need to dive into implementation details of the mitigation. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看崩溃曲线和 lesion-rescue 实验；它提醒 connector 不是小头，many-shot VLM ICL 不能按文本 ICL 直觉外推。
recommendation.en: Read the collapse curves and lesion-rescue setup; it is a useful warning that VLM connectors are not a minor detail and text-ICL priors do not transfer cleanly.

paper.title: A Graph Signal Processing Perspective on Numerical Sequence Representations in LLM In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which

summary.core_problem: 论文想回答一个较窄但有用的问题：LLM 在把数值序列当文本做 in-context learning 时，内部表示是否真的按序列动力学复杂度组织，而不只是最终预测误差看起来有差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。它把注意力矩阵看成 token 图，把 hidden states 看成图上信号，用图谱诊断来分析数值 ICL。这个视角适合补足纯 output-level evaluation 的不足：两个序列族的外推误差可能接近，但内部表示的连通性、频谱能量和谱熵已经不同。对基座模型研究来说，价值在于提供了一套可复用的表征诊断工具，尤其适合研究长上下文中模型如何组织非自然语言结构，例如时间序列、程序 trace、表格和离散化后的多模态 token。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把每一层、每个 attention head 的 post-softmax attention 矩阵视为一个加权图，token hidden states 是定义在图节点上的信号。论文使用三个图谱指标：normalized Fiedler value 衡量 attention 图的全局连通性；high-frequency energy ratio 衡量 hidden-state 信号在图上的粗糙程度；spectral entropy 衡量信号频谱支撑的分散程度。实验输入包括 10 类一维序列族：常数序列、不同 r 参数下的 logistic map 周期轨道和混沌轨道，以及 Lorenz 系统 x 分量。logistic map 被用作主控对象，因为它在相同递推形式下可以沿 period-doubling 路径从低周期过渡到混沌。数值序列被线性缩放到 50 到 950，量化为三位整数，并用逗号分隔；这样三位数字和逗号在常见 tokenizer 中通常是单 token，可以保持数值状态与 token 的一一对应，避免数字被拆分后污染图分析。
summary.experiments: 主要实验每个序列族采样 20 条轨迹，并比较不同 context length 下的层内表示。结论是：context length 增加后，内部表示更清楚地按输入动力学复杂度排序；周期更长、混沌程度更高的序列，在图谱指标上与低复杂度序列分离更明显。论文还指出，某些输入族在最终外推误差上很接近，但 graph-spectral diagnostics 可以区分它们，说明输出误差不是观察数值 ICL 的唯一有效信号。附录还扩展到带 distribution shift、平滑周期变化和随机演化的结构化数值序列，用来检查现象是否只依赖 logistic map 设置。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Methods 中的数值序列序列化设计和三个谱指标定义；这部分决定了分析是否可信。图 1 可以帮助理解 attention graph + hidden-state signal 的建模方式。主结果图和附录中关于 extrapolation error 聚集但表征指标分离的图值得看，因为它们说明这种诊断相对常规误差指标提供了什么额外信息。若关注 tokenizer 和数值表示，建议细看三位整数、逗号分隔、全轨迹先量化再截断这些实现选择；这些细节比图谱术语更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs organize numerical sequence information internally according to dynamical complexity during in-context learning, rather than only showing differences in final prediction error.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic. It proposes a representation-level lens for numerical ICL: attention matrices define token graphs, and hidden states define graph signals. This helps expose structure that output error alone can miss. The same type of analysis could be useful for long-context pretraining studies where the input is structured but serialized as tokens, such as time series, tables, program traces, or discretized multimodal streams.
summary_en.technical_approach: At each transformer layer and attention head, the post-softmax attention matrix is treated as a weighted graph over tokens. Hidden states are treated as node signals on that graph. The paper applies three graph-spectral diagnostics: normalized Fiedler value for global connectivity, high-frequency energy ratio for signal roughness, and spectral entropy for the breadth of spectral support. The controlled input suite contains constant sequences, logistic-map trajectories with increasing periods and chaotic regimes, and the x-component of the Lorenz system. The logistic map is the main controlled family because changing the parameter r moves the dynamics from low-period behavior through period doubling to chaos while preserving the recurrence form. Numerical values are rescaled to 50-950, rounded to zero-padded three-digit integers, and separated by commas, so that numeric values and separators align cleanly with tokens under common tokenizers.
summary_en.experiments: The main suite uses 10 sequence families with 20 trajectory realizations per family. The reported pattern is that longer contexts make internal representations more clearly ordered by input dynamical complexity. Periodic sequences with longer periods and chaotic sequences become more separable from low-complexity inputs in the graph-spectral diagnostics. The paper also notes cases where output extrapolation errors remain tightly clustered while representation-level diagnostics separate the input families. Additional appendix experiments consider structured numerical sequences with distribution shifts, smooth periodic variation, and stochastic evolution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20-30 minutes. Focus on the serialization design and the definitions of the three spectral diagnostics, since these choices determine the validity of the analysis. Figure 1 is useful for the attention-graph and graph-signal framing. The main result figures and the appendix comparison against extrapolation error are the most relevant parts. Readers interested in tokenizer effects should pay attention to the three-digit integer format, comma tokens, and the decision to quantize the full trajectory before truncation.

recommendation.zh: ICL 机制分析的新视角，图谱诊断方法可借鉴；重点看图谱指标和可视化部分，结论偏描述性。
recommendation.en: A new perspective on ICL mechanism analysis; the graph-spectral diagnostic methodology is worth borrowing. Focus on spectral metrics and visualizations; conclusions are mostly descriptive.

paper.title: PromptPath: Prompt-Adaptive Computational Pathways for In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) has attracted increasing attention for enabling models to perform new tasks using only a few ``input--output'' prompt examples. However, existing approaches suffer from \textbf{shallow task adaptation}, where prompts are primarily used as contextual cues to implicitly infer task intent through semantic representations, while the underlying computational process remains unchanged. This limitation restricts task-specific adaptation and compromises inference interpretabili

summary.core_problem: 现有上下文学习（ICL）方法仅将提示作为语义线索，底层计算路径固定，导致任务适配浅、可解释性差。
summary.importance: 提出提示驱动的动态计算路径框架，属于ICL架构方向的方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PromptPath框架，通过提示驱动的路由机制选择性激活和组合轻量级低秩专家，形成任务特定的计算路径。
summary.experiments: 在多个ICL任务上验证适配效果，主要面向CV场景的上下文学习。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing in-context learning (ICL) methods only use prompts as semantic cues while keeping the underlying computation path fixed, leading to shallow task adaptation and poor interpretability.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a prompt-driven dynamic computation pathway framework, a methodological improvement in ICL architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PromptPath, which uses a prompt-driven routing mechanism to selectively activate and compose lightweight low-rank experts, forming task-specific computation pathways.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple ICL tasks, primarily targeting vision-domain in-context learning.

recommendation.zh: CV场景下的ICL动态路由工作，对LLM预训练的直接参考有限，可作为MoE路由思路的补充参考。
recommendation.en: Dynamic routing work for ICL in vision scenarios, with limited direct reference for LLM pretraining; useful as supplementary MoE routing inspiration.

paper.title: Measuring in-context algorithmic reasoning in language models against an exact Bayes-optimal standard
paper.abstract: Whether large language models perform genuine algorithmic reasoning or mere pattern completion is hard to test, because most benchmarks lack a ground truth for correct inductive inference. We introduce F-ICL, an in-context-learning benchmark that supplies one exactly. Using the Turing-complete machine F, complement-symmetrised into sF to remove output-polarity bias, we exhaustively enumerate all 1.5 billion programs of length $L\le13$ and compute the Bayes-optimal posterior in closed form under

summary.core_problem: 如何判断 LLM 的 in-context learning 是真正的算法归纳推理，还是表面模式匹配？现有 benchmark 缺少一个关于「给定证据后理想推断应该是什么」的精确 ground truth，模型只能和其他模型或人类答案比较，无法和正确后验比较。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值偏分析侧而非训练侧。它把 Solomonoff 归纳推理从理论拉到一个可计算、可验证的小规模基准上，给出了一个无调参的 Bayes 最优后验作为标尺，可以用来量化 ICL 收敛速度、归纳偏置和 token 分布与算法先验的偏离。对研究 ICL 机制、预训练数据如何塑造隐式归纳偏置、以及 LM-as-compression 这条线有参考意义，但不直接给出训练改进方案。
summary.technical_approach: 选了一个极小的图灵完备纸带自动机 F（Brainfuck 家族，5 条指令），穷举长度 L≤13 的全部约 15 亿个程序，按有界 universal (Levin–Solomonoff) 先验加权。由于穷举是精确的，程序行为到先验质量的映射就是充分统计量，任意 few-shot 上下文的后验预测可以闭式算出。为消除输出极性偏置，把 F 补对称化为 sF，每个任务配一个按位补码的 twin，最优分数在两者上相同，original-twin gap 就隔离出模型自身的归纳偏置。用 GPU 加速穷举 + 独立 Python 参考实现 + 逐字节交叉校验来认证 ground truth。评测用有界对称散度衡量模型服务分布与最优后验的距离，给出难度感知分数和 facet profile，覆盖 induction、continuation、abduction 三类任务。
summary.experiments: 穷举规模 15 亿程序（L≤13）。在一系列开源和前沿 LLM 上评测，结论是：开源模型能跟住最优趋势但远未达到 Bayes 效率——简单任务能解，困难任务需要的示例数远超必要，且 token 级分布在高置信处与算法先验不匹配。F-ICL 能把 Bayes-rational 推理和强启发式 foil 区分开。具体模型分数和消融在正文结果部分给出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Introduction 中关于「为什么需要精确后验标准」的论证，再看 Methods 里 F 自动机定义、补对称化 sF 和后验闭式计算的部分。图表重点关注难度-散度曲线和 original-twin gap。对预训练研究员，真正值得想的是：这种 Bayes 最优标尺能否用来诊断预训练数据 mixture 对隐式归纳偏置的影响，而不只是评测现成模型。预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to tell whether an LLM's in-context learning reflects genuine algorithmic induction or surface pattern matching?
