Existing benchmarks lack a precise ground truth for what the ideal inference from given evidence should be, so models can only be compared against other models or human answers, never against the correct posterior.
summary_en.importance: The value is analytical rather than recipe-level. It brings Solomonoff induction from theory to a computable, certifiable small-scale benchmark, providing a parameter-free Bayes-optimal posterior as a yardstick. This lets researchers quantify ICL convergence speed, inductive bias, and the divergence of token-level distributions from an algorithmic prior. It is relevant to work on ICL mechanisms, how pretraining data shapes implicit inductive bias, and the LM-as-compression line, but it does not directly propose a training improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: A minimal Turing-complete tape automaton F (Brainfuck family, five instructions) is fixed, and all ~1.5 billion programs of length L≤13 are exhaustively enumerated under a bounded universal (Levin–Solomonoff) prior. Because enumeration is exact, the map from program behavior to prior mass is a sufficient statistic, and the posterior predictive for any few-shot context is computed in closed form. To remove output-polarity bias, F is complement-symmetrized into sF; each task is paired with its bitwise complement twin, on which the optimum scores identically, so the original-twin gap isolates the model's own inductive bias. Ground-truth certification uses GPU-accelerated enumeration, an independent pure-Python reference, and exact cross-checks (byte-for-byte agreement of per-output program counts, witness re-execution, bit-identical posterior agreement). Models are scored with a bounded symmetric divergence against the optimal posterior, summarized by a difficulty-aware score and facet profile across induction, continuation, and abduction tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Enumeration covers 1.5 billion programs at L≤13. Across a panel of open-weight and frontier LLMs, open models track the optimal trend but fall well short of Bayes efficiency: they solve easy tasks, need far more examples than necessary on harder ones, and produce token-level distributions that are confidently mismatched with the algorithmic prior. F-ICL separates Bayes-rational inference from strong heuristic foils. Per-model scores and ablations are in the results section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Start with the Introduction's argument for why an exact posterior standard is needed, then the Methods section defining the F automaton, the sF complement symmetrization, and the closed-form posterior. Focus on figures showing difficulty-vs-divergence curves and the original-twin gap. For pretrain researchers, the productive question is whether such a Bayes-optimal yardstick can diagnose how pretraining data mixture shapes implicit inductive bias, rather than only evaluating finished models. Estimated 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用算法信息论构造贝叶斯最优 ICL 参照系的思路很干净，重点看 §3 基准构造和 Fig 5 模型偏离度分析。
recommendation.en: Clean approach to building a Bayes-optimal ICL reference via algorithmic information theory; focus on §3 benchmark construction and Fig. 5 model deviation analysis.

paper.title: Why Large Language Models Fail at Tabular Prediction
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become the default tool for a remarkable range of tasks, yet they have had conspicuously little success at one of the most common machine learning workloads: predictive analytics over tabular data. This gap is the founding premise of the fast-growing field of tabular foundation models, but the question of why generic LLMs fail has remained open. We study a frontier LLM in its purest inference regime - a single generation pass over a prompt containing the full tr

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个具体问题：通用指令调优自回归 LLM 在纯 prompt 推理模式下，为什么很难做表格分类。设定很克制：一次用户输入包含完整训练表和测试特征，不使用工具、代码执行、多轮交互、检索、系统提示或微调。论文关心的不是如何把分数做高，而是定位核心模型自身的能力边界。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在两个方面。第一，它把表格预测失败从“提示格式不好”或“数字 tokenization 不好”这类直觉解释中剥离出来，指向更基础的高维 in-context 学习限制。第二，它提示当前 LLM 的 ICL 机制可能更像低维局部相似性匹配，而不是稳定地在上下文中拟合一个经典监督学习器。这个结论对数据合成、数值能力预训练、表格/结构化数据混合训练都有参考意义：只增加表格样式语料或改 CSV 序列化，未必能解决高维特征学习问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计了五个候选假设并逐一干预：类别重叠或非线性可分性、CSV 线性化破坏列结构、数字 tokenization、单次 prompt 中测试样本数量、输入维度。实验固定在纯推理模式，避免把外部 scaffold 的能力混入模型能力。关键设计是用随机线性投影控制信息量，在不同维度下观察模型和传统方法的性能变化。为了避免 benchmark 污染带来的误判，作者还加入了 memorisation probe，先检查模型是否可能记住公开数据集。行为建模部分则不是只看准确率，而是比较 LLM 的预测边界和一组经典学习器的逐点预测一致性，包括 Gaussian process、kNN 以及大量配置过的传统分类器。
summary.experiments: 核心结果很集中。LLM 在二维或低维表格任务上可以做出有意义预测，但表格变宽后性能明显下降。在 31 个 benchmark 数据集的随机线性投影 sweep 中，九种方法里只有 LLM 的准确率会随特征维度增加而系统下降。前四个解释被针对性实验削弱：更换序列化方式、处理数字表示、改变测试 batch 大小、控制类别分离程度，都不能解释主要失败。低维时，LLM 的决策边界可以被短 length-scale 的 Gaussian process 和低 k 的 kNN 很好复现，二维网格预测一致性约 91–92%。高维时，作者尝试 252 个配置的经典 baseline，最高只能达到 64.8% 的预测一致性；再给每个 baseline 加上按维度调参的 label-noise 模型，提升最多只有 0.64 个百分点。定性分析还显示，模型生成的解释经常和自身预测不一致，或者直接承认是在猜测。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。优先看实验设定和假设检验部分：Section 5 的污染检查、Section 6 对 H1–H4 的反证、Section 7 的维度 sweep。最值得细看的是随机投影实验，因为它把“维度增加”和“信息增加”拆开了。Section 8 的行为建模也值得看，尤其是二维边界拟合和高维 surrogate 失败的对比。Section 9 的推理 trace 可快速浏览，它更多说明语言解释不可靠，不是主要证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why a generic instruction-tuned autoregressive LLM fails at tabular classification when used as a bare in-context learner. The setup deliberately removes tools, code execution, retrieval, multi-turn scaffolding, custom system prompts, and fine-tuning. The object of study is the model’s single-pass behavior on a prompt containing the full training table and the test features.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. The failure is not well explained by common surface hypotheses such as CSV serialization, numeric tokenization, test batching, or class overlap. The evidence points instead to a high-dimensional in-context learning limitation. This matters for structured-data pretraining: adding more table-shaped text or changing the textual format may not be enough if the model lacks a robust mechanism for fitting supervised predictors over many numeric features in context.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors test five hypotheses with controlled interventions: noisy or non-linearly separable data, loss of column structure from linearized CSV, numeric value tokenization, the number of test queries in one prompt, and feature dimensionality. They also include a memorization probe to reduce contamination artifacts. The most important design is a random linear projection sweep over benchmark datasets, which changes dimensionality while controlling the information content. For behavioral modeling, they compare LLM predictions against classical learners and measure prediction agreement, not only task accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that the LLM can perform meaningful in-context classification on narrow tables, especially in two dimensions, but collapses as feature dimensionality grows. In a sweep over 31 benchmark datasets and nine methods, the LLM is the only method whose accuracy systematically decreases as features are added under random projections. In two-dimensional tasks, its decision boundaries are closely reproduced by local distance-based methods: Gaussian processes with short length scales and low-k nearest neighbors reach about 91–92% grid agreement. In higher dimensions, none of 252 configured classical baselines matches the model well; the best prediction agreement is 64.8%. Adding a tuned dimension-dependent label-noise model improves agreement by at most 0.64 percentage points. The model’s natural-language explanations often do not match its actual predictions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 30–45 minutes. Read the contamination probe first, then the hypothesis tests for serialization, numeric representation, and test-batch size. The key section is the dimensionality sweep with random projections, because it separates feature count from information content. The behavioral modeling section is also useful: the contrast between near-local behavior in 2D and the failure to find a high-dimensional surrogate is the strongest empirical signal. The qualitative reasoning traces can be read quickly as supporting evidence rather than the main result.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和维度 sweep；它把“LLM 不懂表格”收窄成可测 failure mode，适合校准 ICL prior。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and dimensionality sweeps; it turns vague tabular failure into a measurable ICL failure mode.

paper.title: Versatile On-device Adaptation at the Edge by Unifying Few-shot, Zero-shot, Continual, and In-context Learning
paper.abstract: With the ever-increasing pervasiveness of smart edge devices, the demand is growing for applications that can be tailored to users (e.g., custom keyword spotting) or patients (e.g., adaptive health monitoring). Yet, most edge devices rely on fixed inference algorithms and thus cannot learn on-device to personalize predictions. When they can, devices typically support only a specific learning scenario, such as few-shot learning (FSL): going beyond this requires resorting either to another special

summary.core_problem: 边缘设备通常只支持单一学习场景（如few-shot），无法在设备端统一处理多种在线学习需求且需依赖云端重训练
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出统一四种在线学习范式的边缘设备自适应框架，在嵌入式场景下实现低能耗个性化学习
summary.technical_approach: 提出embedder-centric learning (ECL)框架，以嵌入器为核心统一few-shot、continual、zero-shot和in-context learning四种在线学习场景
summary.experiments: 在边缘设备场景下验证，支持关键词检测、健康监测等个性化任务，相比专用方案降低能耗和延迟

summary_en.core_problem: Edge devices typically support only a single learning scenario (e.g., few-shot) and rely on cloud retraining, incurring energy/latency costs and privacy risks
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: a unified on-device adaptation framework that consolidates four online learning paradigms for low-power edge personalization
summary_en.technical_approach: Embedder-Centric Learning (ECL) unifies four online learning scenarios—few-shot, continual, zero-shot, and in-context learning—around a shared embedder module
summary_en.experiments: Validated on edge devices for keyword spotting and adaptive health monitoring, reducing energy and latency compared to specialized approaches

recommendation.zh: 边缘端小模型在线学习框架，与LLM基座预训练关联弱，仅作ICL在资源受限场景应用的参考
recommendation.en: On-device small-model adaptation framework with weak relevance to LLM pretraining; useful only as reference for ICL in resource-constrained settings

paper.title: Gradient-free Task-Conditioned Retrieval for On-Device In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: On-device in-context learning (ICL) relies on pre-inference retrieval to select demonstrations for useful context before downstream model inference. This retrieval must exploit task-specific information while operating over local memories under limited computation, memory, and data-exposure budgets. We propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment (CoRA), a gradient-free framework that converts a frozen encoder into a task-conditioned retriever using paired candidate inputs and outputs. CoRA selects c

summary.core_problem: 在端侧 ICL 场景中，如何在不能训练模型、计算和隐私预算有限的条件下，为当前任务检索更合适的 demonstrations。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG/ICL 检索方法改进。它不直接改变预训练方法，但触及一个有用问题：上下文示例选择是否能用轻量闭式方法获得任务条件化，而不依赖梯度更新或在线访问输出标签。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Conditional Retrieval Alignment，简称 CoRA。方法冻结 encoder，用候选输入-输出对构造任务条件空间；选择互补 encoder 层，通过闭式 ridge regression 将候选输入表示对齐到由输出派生的空间；再用低秩分解得到紧凑检索基。候选输出只在离线建索引时使用，查询时只需输入和预计算索引。
summary.experiments: 摘要称给出了 rank-constrained basis 的最优低秩压缩性质，并在端侧 ICL 检索任务中验证。公开摘要未提供具体任务、模型、设备预算、baseline 或提升幅度，需要正文确认是否只是 retrieval reranking 的常规增量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses task-specific demonstration retrieval for on-device ICL under frozen-model, limited-compute, limited-memory, and data-exposure constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a retrieval method for RAG/ICL. It does not directly affect pretraining, but it is relevant to how lightweight task conditioning can be obtained without gradient updates or online access to candidate labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment, or CoRA. A frozen encoder is adapted by using paired candidate inputs and outputs: complementary encoder layers are selected, an output-derived conditioning space is built, input representations are aligned to that space via closed-form ridge regression, and low-rank factorization yields a compact retrieval basis. Candidate outputs are used only during offline indexing; query-time retrieval uses only the input and precomputed index.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states an optimal low-rank compression result for the rank-constrained basis and reports empirical validation for on-device ICL retrieval. It does not provide task lists, model sizes, hardware budgets, baselines, or gains, so the full paper is needed to judge whether the result is more than incremental reranking.

recommendation.zh: 作为端侧 ICL 检索备查即可；重点看 ridge 对齐的闭式推导，实验若缺少强 retriever baseline 就别过度解读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for on-device ICL retrieval; read the closed-form ridge alignment, but do not overread the results without strong retriever baselines.

paper.title: Extracting Algorithms in Pre-trained LLMs: A Case on Hidden Markov Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) display a striking ability to predict next observations from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) via in-context learning (ICL), but the algorithm underlying this capability remains undetermined: prior work has proposed several candidates without consensus, and none has been grounded in the model's internal activations. We close this gap with a three-stage pipeline. First, we empirically compare LLM behavior against a suite of candidate algorithms and narrow the space to thre

summary.core_problem: 预训练 LLM 在 HMM 观测序列上能做很强的 in-context next-token prediction，甚至随上下文增长接近 Bayes 最优预测；但它到底在内部实现了哪类算法，此前没有和模型激活做过因果层面的对应。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在机制分析，而不是直接给出新的预训练 recipe。它把 HMM 这种可控生成过程当作探针，研究预训练 Transformer 是否学到了可迁移的统计推断算法。对基座研究的启发在于：ICL 行为不能只用输出拟合来解释，同一个模型在不同数据生成机制下可能调用不同的内部表示；激活中可线性解码的信息，也不一定被后续计算真实使用。这对理解预训练后模型如何形成算法性能力有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一步，在 75 个 HMM 配置和多种上下文长度上，把 12 个预训练 LLM 的 next-observation prediction 与一组经典和学习型 HMM predictor 对齐比较。作者没有假设单一机制，而是用输出行为把候选空间收窄到三类 ansatz：Linear n-gram、Non-linear n-gram 和 Spectral。第二步，证明 Transformer 可以在上下文中实现这些候选算法。核心统一形式是：把历史观测映射成一组非线性特征，再用这些特征的线性函数给出 next-token probability。这个形式把有限窗口 n-gram、非线性特征预测和谱方法放到同一个框架里。作者还在一个小 Transformer 上验证，训练后确实会自然出现类似有限窗口 predictor 的实现。第三步，引入 Principal Activations Probe（PAP）。PAP 先在 residual stream 中寻找低维算法信号，再通过层级干预检验这些信号是否因果影响输出。这个设计比普通 probing 更强，因为它区分了“能读出来”和“模型真的用它”。
summary.experiments: 关键实验包括三类结果。第一，输出行为上，预训练 LLM 在合成 HMM 序列上随上下文增长趋近理论最优预测，但没有任何单一经典算法能解释所有 HMM regime 和序列长度下的行为。第二，理论构造和小模型训练实验显示，Transformer 架构有能力在 in-context setting 中实现三类候选算法，有限窗口 predictor 也能在训练中自然形成。第三，PAP 分析显示，不同 HMM regime 下模型会使用不同类型的算法表示；不同计算阶段分布在不同层；一些算法信息在较早层已经可解码，但并没有被后续层用于最终预测。这一点是全文最有信息量的实验结论之一。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30–45 分钟。先看 Section 2.3 和 Table 1，理解 12 个 LLM、75 个 HMM 配置、候选 predictor 的比较方式，以及为什么单一算法解释失败。再看 Section 3 的统一 nonlinear-feature 表达，它是连接 n-gram、nonlinear predictor 和 spectral method 的核心。最后重点看 Section 4 的 PAP，包括 probing 与 intervention 的流程图和干预结果。若只关心预训练模型机制，Section 4 比理论构造更值得细读。

summary_en.core_problem: Pre-trained LLMs can perform strong in-context next-observation prediction on HMM-generated sequences, often approaching the Bayes-optimal predictor as context grows. The open question is which algorithm, if any, the model implements internally, and whether that algorithm can be tied causally to model activations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly mechanistic, not a new pretraining method. HMMs provide a controlled generative process for testing whether pre-trained Transformers contain transferable statistical inference procedures. The useful lesson for foundation-model research is that output-level matching is not enough: the same model can rely on different internal representations under different data regimes, and linearly decodable information in an activation need not be causally used by later computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has three parts. First, it compares 12 pre-trained LLMs against a set of classical and learning-based HMM predictors over 75 HMM configurations and a range of context lengths. This behavioral comparison rules out a single universal explanation and narrows the plausible mechanisms to three ansatz classes: Linear n-gram, Non-linear n-gram, and Spectral. Second, it shows that Transformers can implement these classes in context. The unifying view expresses next-token probabilities as linear functions of nonlinear features computed from past observations, which covers finite-window predictors, nonlinear feature predictors, and spectral-style methods. A small Transformer trained on a single HMM is used to validate that a finite-window-like predictor can emerge naturally. Third, the paper introduces Principal Activations Probe, a layer-wise probing and intervention pipeline that finds low-dimensional algorithmic signals in the residual stream and then tests whether changing those signals causally changes predictions.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical results are clear. At the output level, pre-trained LLMs improve with context length and move toward the theoretical optimum on synthetic HMM sequences, but no single baseline algorithm matches their behavior across all regimes. The construction experiments show that the candidate algorithms are implementable by Transformers, and the small-model training run demonstrates that at least one such solution can arise from training rather than manual wiring. The activation analysis shows regime-dependent internal strategies, layer-localized computational stages, and a gap between decodability and causal use: some algorithmic information is present in earlier layers but is bypassed by downstream computation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Start with Section 2.3 and Table 1 to understand the HMM grid, the predictor baselines, and why output behavior does not identify a unique algorithm. Then read Section 3 for the common nonlinear-feature formulation that connects the three candidate mechanisms. Spend the most time on Section 4, especially the PAP design and intervention results, since those are the strongest evidence about what the pre-trained models actually use.

recommendation.zh: ICL机制研究的扎实工作，PAP探针方法有复用价值，重点看§3的算法分类和§5的激活验证部分。
recommendation.en: Solid ICL mechanism work with a reusable PAP probing method; focus on Section 3 for algorithm taxonomy and Section 5 for activation validation.

paper.title: Context Is King: How In-Context Specification Shapes the Geometry of Concepts
paper.abstract: Large language models place structured concepts on geometrically faithful manifolds: weekdays lie on a circle, months on another, usually taken to be a fixed world-model the network stores and looks up. We show that context is king: the structure a model actually uses is set by the in-context specification. A declarative rule fixes not only which relations the geometry encodes but its topology type: the same tokens form a cycle or a branching tree on command, built even on arbitrary, meaning-fre

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是LLM中概念的关系几何结构（如星期、月份的环形布局，层次概念的树形结构）究竟是预训练阶段存储的固定世界模型，还是由上下文规范即时动态构建的。此前的可解释性研究多将观测到的概念几何视为模型预训练固化的静态属性，这篇工作通过受控实验验证上下文对概念几何的决定作用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有四点：1. 概念表示不是预训练固化的静态结构，而是上下文依赖的动态构建，说明预训练学到的是构建概念关系结构的能力，而非固定的几何布局；2. 上下文覆盖强预训练先验的能力存在规模门控效应，为scaling law研究提供了性能之外的新维度——内部表示的上下文重构能力；3. 上下文学习不只是调整输出分布，而是直接重构模型内部的概念表示空间，为理解ICL的机制提供了新证据；4. 小模型上的概念几何研究结论不能直接迁移到大模型，因为忠实的、可因果使用的结构需要足够的模型能力支撑。
summary.technical_approach: 采用声明式零示例的上下文规范方法，对不同预训练先验强度的实体集合（从强环形先验的星期、月份，到弱先验的星座，再到无先验的任意无意义token）强加与预训练先验一致或冲突的概念结构（顺序环形、层次树形）。读取模型最后一个prompt token处的残差流表示（即生成前的集成状态，而非结构查询诱导的状态），通过成对不相似度、表示相似性分析（RSA）等方法测量概念几何的拓扑与结构。核心创新包括：验证拓扑级别的变化（环形vs树形）而非固定形状内的偏移；通过冲突规范区分上下文与预训练先验的影响；通过激活补丁实验验证上下文设定的几何是被模型因果使用的，而非探针的伪相关。
summary.experiments: 关键实验结果包括：1. 对星期等强预训练环形概念施加冲突顺序时，模型表示的几何结构会转向上下文指定的结构，与强加结构的表示相似性达0.6-0.9；2. 同一组实体的几何拓扑完全由上下文规范决定——指定顺序则形成环形/线性结构，指定层次则形成树形结构；3. 即使是无预训练先验的任意无意义token，上下文也能构建出清晰的结构化几何，排除了「重标记预存结构」的解释；4. 实体替换的激活补丁实验证明，上下文设定的几何是模型生成时实际因果使用的，不是探针的虚假相关；5. 小模型和base模型只能形成粗糙的强加几何，干净的、可遍历的结构以及完整的因果双分离效应仅在更大规模模型上出现，存在明显的能力门控。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点关注第1节的核心问题与核心结论，第4节的几何测量方法（特别是选择最后一个prompt token残差流作为读取位置的原因），第5节的冲突实验与拓扑切换实验结果，以及第6节的因果验证与规模效应分析。关注机制可解释性的读者可深入查看激活补丁的实验设计。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: A core question in LLM interpretability is whether the relational geometry of concepts (e.g., cyclic structure of weekdays/months, tree structure of hierarchical concepts) is a fixed world model stored during pretraining, or dynamically constructed on demand by in-context specifications. Prior work has largely treated observed concept geometries as static, pretrained properties of the model. This work uses controlled experiments to test whether in-context specification directly determines the geometry a model actually uses.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work delivers four key insights: 1. Concept representations are not static, pretrained structures but context-dependent dynamic constructs, indicating pretraining learns the capacity to build conceptual relational structures rather than fixed geometric layouts. 2. The ability of context to override strong pretrained priors is scale-gated, adding a new dimension to scaling law analysis beyond raw task performance: the capacity for context-driven representational reorganization. 3. In-context learning does not merely adjust output distributions — it directly reshapes the internal representational space of concepts, providing new mechanistic evidence for how ICL works. 4. Findings about concept geometry from small models cannot be directly transferred to large models, as faithful, causally operative structure requires sufficient model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work uses declarative, zero-exemplar in-context specifications to impose conceptual structures (ordered cycles, hierarchical trees) that are either congruent or conflicting with pretrained priors. Tests cover entity types with varying prior strength: strong cyclic concepts (weekdays, months, clock hours), weak cyclic priors (zodiac signs), non-cyclic concepts (musical notes), and arbitrary meaningless tokens. Entity representations are read from the residual stream at the last prompt token — the integrated state consumed by next-token computation, rather than states induced by structural queries — and geometry is measured via pairwise dissimilarity and representational similarity analysis (RSA). Key innovations include: demonstrating topology-level control (cycle vs. tree) rather than just within-shape shifts; using conflicting specifications to disentangle context vs. pretrained prior effects; and using activation patching (entity substitution) to verify the context-set geometry is causally operative in generation, not just a probe correlate.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings include: 1. When a conflicting order is imposed on strong cyclic concepts (e.g., scrambled weekday order), the model's representational geometry shifts to match the imposed structure, with representational similarity to the specified structure reaching 0.6–0.9. 2. The same set of entities forms either a cyclic/linear structure or a hierarchical tree structure depending solely on the in-context specification, demonstrating full topology-level control. 3. Structured geometry can be formed even on arbitrary, meaningless tokens with no pretrained prior, ruling out relabeling of stored shapes as an explanation. 4. Entity-substitution activation patching confirms the context-set geometry is causally used in generation, not just a spurious probe correlation. 5. Small and base models only form rough imposed geometries; clean, traversable structure and full causal double dissociation emerge only at larger model scales, showing clear capability gating.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on Section 1 for the core research question and key claims, Section 4 for the measurement methodology (especially the rationale for reading representations from the last prompt token's residual stream), Section 5 for the conflict and topology-switch experiments, and Section 6 for causal validation and scale-gating results. Readers interested in mechanistic interpretability can dive deeper into the activation patching experimental design. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 RSA 与 patching 设计；它把“概念流形是存储结构”这个 prior 改成了更强的上下文构造版本。
recommendation.en: Read the RSA and patching setup; it shifts the prior from stored concept manifolds toward context-constructed representations.

paper.title: Grounding latent algorithm routing in transformer reasoning
paper.abstract: A central question in the in-context learning literature is whether transformers can organize episode-level adaptation around different inductive-bias families. We study this question in a controlled setting through latent algorithm routing: route-like behavior in which the solver-family preference changes with the latent data-generating regime while prompt form is held fixed, remains stable under nuisance perturbations, and is selectively influenced by targeted activation interventions without

summary.core_problem: 该工作关注一个较窄但有意义的问题：在同一种 prompt 形式下，dense decoder-only Transformer 是否会根据 episode 的潜在数据生成机制，选择不同的“算法族”来完成 in-context learning。它要排除三类常见误判：模型只是利用格式线索、模型只是连续插值不同解法、probe 只是事后读出了相关信号但没有参与计算。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。它把 ICL 中的“模型会不会在上下文内做算法选择”变成了可测的诊断问题，并给出 RouteBench 这样一个受控环境。对基座研究员有用的地方在于：它把 route-like computation 拆成结构必要性、表面扰动不变性、因果可编辑性三个条件。这个框架可以迁移到更真实的预训练模型分析，例如研究模型在数学、代码、检索、鲁棒估计等任务之间是否形成可干预的内部计算分工。它也和 MoE 的显式路由形成对照：dense 模型里可能存在可读出的软路由变量，但这不等于存在硬符号 router。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕 RouteBench 展开。一个 episode 由 support set 和 query 组成，序列化格式固定，变化的是潜在 regime。作者构造四类具有不同归纳偏置的 solver family：ridge-like 对应全局 shrinkage，lasso-like 对应稀疏性，Huber-like 对应重尾噪声下的鲁棒性，kNN-like 对应局部相似性。训练时不给 route label，测试时用模型输出与各 solver 输出的距离定义行为代理：模型当前答案更接近哪一类 solver，就把它视为偏向该 route。这个代理不是硬路由真值，而是为了做行为和因果诊断。核心设计有三点：第一，latent regime 改变但 prompt syntax 不变时，偏好的 solver family 应该系统变化；第二，表面扰动、自然语言渲染等 nuisance perturbation 不应显著改变 route；第三，通过 targeted activation intervention 能选择性改变 route identity，同时不大幅破坏答案质量。作者还设置了固定 solver、全局 mixture、input-conditioned soft mixture、unsupervised Gumbel router、privileged-stat router 和 oracle upper bound 作为参照，并加入 probe permutation、matched patching、route-proxy margin、四路统一设置和 Switch-MoE 诊断来控制读出伪相关。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 pairwise RouteBench 和统一四路设置。主要现象是：较大的 dense decoder-only Transformer 在固定 prompt 形式下，会随潜在数据 regime 改变而表现出不同 solver-family 偏好；这种偏好在若干表面扰动和自然语言渲染下保持相对稳定；中间激活中可以解码出 route-like 变量；对目标激活做 patching 或编辑时，route proxy 的变化大于答案质量的退化。对照实验包括 probe permutation 和 matched patching，用来检验读出信号是否只是训练 probe 的伪相关。文中可确认的实验设计较完整，但给出的文本片段没有暴露具体参数量、数据规模、各表格数值和提升幅度，因此不宜补写具体数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 latent algorithm routing 的定义，重点理解三个判据：structural necessity、nuisance invariance、causal editability。然后看 RouteBench 的 regime 和 solver-family 构造，判断这些归纳偏置是否足够可分。实验部分优先看四类结果：route proxy 的 margin 分析、自然语言和格式扰动下的稳定性、activation intervention 或 patching、probe permutation 和 matched controls。最值得深挖的是“行为上接近某个 solver”与“内部真的存在参与计算的 route variable”之间的差距；作者的干预实验就是为了缩小这个差距，但仍不能证明模型实现了离散算法路由。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether dense decoder-only Transformers can condition their in-context computation on the latent data-generating regime, while the surface form of the prompt is held fixed. The target is not ordinary accuracy. The target is to distinguish genuine route-like algorithm selection from prompt-template artifacts, smooth interpolation among solvers, or probes that merely decode a correlated state after the computation has already happened.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly mechanistic and diagnostic, not a new pretraining recipe. It gives a controlled way to study whether in-context learning contains episode-level variables that behave like algorithm-family choices. The useful part for pretraining research is the decomposition of routing evidence into three tests: the preferred solver should change when the latent regime changes, remain stable under nuisance perturbations, and be causally editable through targeted activation interventions. This framing is also useful when comparing dense models with explicit MoE routing: a dense model may contain decodable soft routing structure without implementing a hard symbolic router.
summary_en.technical_approach: RouteBench constructs episodes with a support set and a query. The serialization is kept fixed, while the latent regime changes. The solver bank contains four clean representatives of different inductive biases: ridge-like solvers for global shrinkage, lasso-like solvers for sparsity, Huber-like solvers for robustness to heavy-tailed noise, and kNN-like solvers for locality. Route labels are never given to the dense Transformers. At evaluation time, the model answer is compared with the outputs of these solver families, and the closest solver family defines a behavioral route proxy. The paper then checks whether this proxy satisfies structural necessity, nuisance invariance, and causal editability. The baselines include fixed solver representatives, a global mixture, an input-conditioned soft mixture, an unsupervised Gumbel router, privileged-statistic routers, and an oracle. Additional controls include natural-language renderings, a unified four-way setting, route-margin checks, probe permutation controls, matched patching controls, and Switch-MoE diagnostics.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments cover pairwise RouteBench settings and a unified four-way setting. The main finding is that larger dense decoder-only Transformers show regime-dependent solver-family preferences under fixed syntax. These preferences are relatively stable under nuisance surface perturbations and natural-language renderings. Route-like variables are decodable from intermediate activations, and targeted activation interventions can shift the inferred route more than they degrade answer quality. Probe permutation and matched patching controls are used to reduce the risk that the signal is only a spurious readout. The provided text does not expose exact model sizes, data scales, or table-level numerical gains, so the reliable summary is about the experimental structure and qualitative conclusions rather than specific numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is enough for most readers. Focus first on the definition of latent algorithm routing and the three grounding criteria. Then inspect the construction of RouteBench and ask whether the four solver families are cleanly separated enough to support the claim. In the experiments, prioritize the route-margin analysis, nuisance-invariance tests, activation patching or intervention results, and the probe permutation or matched-control sections. The main technical point to examine is the gap between behavioral solver similarity and a causally active internal routing variable; the intervention experiments are the strongest part of the evidence, but they still do not prove a discrete internal router.

recommendation.zh: ICL机制研究的新角度，重点看§3的路由定义和§4的规模实验，理解Transformer隐式选择归纳偏置的能力。
recommendation.en: Novel angle on ICL mechanism; focus on §3 routing definition and §4 scaling experiments to understand Transformers' implicit inductive bias selection.

paper.title: In-Context Learning as Implicit Policy Gradient
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can iteratively improve their outputs by incorporating generated samples and their corresponding evaluation scores as in-context examples. Despite these empirical findings, the theoretical foundations underlying this phenomenon remain poorly understood. In this paper, we show that score-conditioned In-Context Learning (ICL) admits a structural correspondence to policy gradient optimization. We first provide a constructive proof that self-at

summary.core_problem: 现有上下文学习（ICL）的理论框架仅覆盖监督学习场景下输入输出对(x,y)的学习机制，无法解释分数条件ICL（模型利用自生成样本及其评价分数(y,r)对迭代优化输出，如OPRO、自奖励对齐等经验现象）背后的学习算法本质，存在理论空白。
summary.importance: 建立了分数条件ICL与策略梯度优化的结构对应关系，为理解无参数更新下的奖励式上下文适应提供理论基础，对提示优化、自奖励对齐、上下文RL等方法的设计有指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 构造性证明：在特定权重矩阵配置下，自注意力机制可实现类似REINFORCE算法的奖励加权聚合——注意力权重由样本分数而非输入相似度加权，在隐状态空间产生向高奖励输出的分数加权更新，结构上等价于REINFORCE策略梯度估计；2. 理论推导：注意力诱导的隐状态更新对输出分布的KL偏移存在精确上界，具有类似信任域的性质；3. 实验验证：在多个主流LLM上验证三个核心预测：样本分数与输出概率变化正相关、注意力权重与分数相关、ICL与显式REINFORCE微调的输出分布偏移方向一致。
summary.experiments: 在Llama-3、Olmo-3、Qwen-3、GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5、Claude Sonnet 4共6个模型上完成验证，三个核心结论：1）上下文样本分数与模型输出概率变化呈正秩相关；2）注意力权重与样本分数存在相关性，为分数加权聚合提供机制层面证据；3）给定相同样本，ICL诱导的输出分布偏移与显式REINFORCE微调的偏移方向相似。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章的理论对应证明与第4章的实验验证部分，附录F补充了预训练模型行为的实证证据。预计阅读时间30-45分钟，关注构造性证明的假设条件与相关性分析结果即可，无需深究数学推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing theoretical frameworks for in-context learning (ICL) only explain learning from supervised input-output (x,y) pairs, leaving no principled account for score-conditioned ICL — where models iteratively improve outputs using self-generated samples and their evaluation scores (y,r) pairs, as seen in OPRO and self-rewarding alignment.
summary_en.importance: Establishes a structural correspondence between score-conditioned ICL and policy gradient optimization, providing a theoretical foundation for understanding reward-based in-context adaptation without parameter updates. Informs the design of prompt optimization, self-rewarding alignment, and in-context RL methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: First provides a constructive proof that under specific weight matrix configurations, self-attention implements reward-weighted aggregation analogous to the REINFORCE algorithm: attention weights scale by sample scores rather than input similarity, producing score-weighted updates toward high-reward outputs in hidden state space, structurally equivalent to the REINFORCE policy gradient estimator. Second proves that attention-induced hidden state updates yield an exact upper bound on KL divergence from the reference distribution, a trust-region-like property. Third validates three core predictions across multiple LLMs: positive correlation between sample scores and output probability changes, correlation between attention weights and scores, and aligned distribution shift direction between ICL and explicit REINFORCE fine-tuning given identical samples.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 6 mainstream LLMs: Llama-3, Olmo-3, Qwen-3, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5, and Claude Sonnet 4. Three core findings: (1) positive rank correlation between context sample scores and output probability changes; (2) correlation between attention weights and sample scores, providing mechanistic evidence for score-weighted aggregation; (3) ICL and explicit REINFORCE fine-tuning shift output distributions in similar directions given identical samples.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for the core theoretical correspondence and Section 4 for experimental validation. Appendix F has supplementary empirical evidence of pretrained model behavior. Estimated reading time: 30-45 minutes. Focus on the assumptions of the constructive proof and correlation results; detailed mathematical derivations can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: 简化模型下的构造性证明，解释了上下文加（样本，分数）为何能实现类PG改进，读核心构造即可，勿过度推广到全规模大模型。
recommendation.en: Constructive proof under simplified settings explaining why (sample, score) pairs in context enable PG-like improvement; read the core construction but avoid overgeneralizing to full-scale LLMs.

paper.title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
paper.abstract: Real-world agent learning is often constrained by costly environment interactions, such as running time-consuming experiments or obtaining human feedback. In-context learning offers a highly sample-efficient way for agents to learn from their own interaction histories, but its gains disappear once that experience is removed from the context. Separately, context distillation provides a mechanism for internalizing contextual information into model weights. However, applying it to agents' interacti

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：在环境交互昂贵的 agent 场景里，如何把 in-context learning 从历史经验中获得的收益，尽量蒸馏进模型参数，而不再额外消耗环境交互样本。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 post-ICL / agent learning 接口上的方法创新。它不直接改 pretrain，但对“上下文中的经验能否被离线内化”为权重知识、以及如何在低交互预算下做 continual adaptation，有明确启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Experience Distillation：先收集 agent 的交互历史，再在不新增环境交互的前提下，把这些历史作为蒸馏源，将 ICL 中体现出的策略/经验转移到模型权重。论文强调这不同于直接对经验做 SFT，因为目标是保留 ICL 的行为收益，而不是仅拟合轨迹文本。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 749 个软件工程任务和 6 个文字冒险游戏。关键结果是：该方法在两个领域都能保留至少 64.8% 的 ICL 收益，而直接在收集到的经验上做监督微调只能恢复更少收益。摘要未给出底模规模、蒸馏细节和完整 baseline 列表，但从设定看，比较对象至少包括 ICL 上下文使用和直接 SFT。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to internalize gains from in-context learning over agent interaction histories into model weights, without requiring any additional environment interaction.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution at the agent-learning / post-ICL interface. It does not change pretraining directly, but it is relevant to continual adaptation under expensive interaction budgets and to the broader question of whether contextual experience can be converted into persistent parametric knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Experience Distillation: collect an agent's interaction history, then distill the behavior enabled by that history into the model parameters offline. The key distinction from naive supervised fine-tuning is that the goal is to preserve the gains of ICL from experience, not merely imitate logged trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover 749 curated software-engineering tasks and six text-adventure games. The headline result is that the method retains at least 64.8% of the gains from in-context learning across both domains, whereas direct supervised fine-tuning on the same collected experience recovers substantially less. The abstract does not specify base model sizes or full baseline details.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是直接增益，但它碰到一个真问题：上下文经验并不等价于 SFT 数据；只看实验设定和 ICL→weights 的蒸馏差距就够了。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but it hits a real issue: contextual experience is not interchangeable with SFT data; the ICL-to-weights gap is the part worth reading.

paper.title: Lifted Representation Hypothesis in Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often answer queries by mapping individual observations to more general rule-like structures. However, it remains unclear how these structures are stored, selected, and revised. To study this process, we propose thelifted representation hypothesis: LLMs update memory through shared latent structures rather than isolated instance-level facts. This view frames lifting as an efficient use of symmetry across instances, and shattering as the refinement of coarse lifted st

summary.core_problem: 论文研究的是：LLM在学习规则与例外时，是否倾向于把多个样本压到共享的潜在“类型”表示里，而不是逐条记忆实例；以及当后续出现例外时，模型能否把原先过粗的共享表示重新拆开。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于它给“模型如何形成抽象、又为何难以修正抽象”提供了一个可操作的分析框架。这个框架把 generalization、memory editing、ICL 更新和 fine-tuning 中的例外学习放到同一视角下：如果样本梯度方向一致，模型更容易形成共享表示；但一旦早期抽象过粗，后续修正就会受到结构性阻力。对做数据配比、课程学习、持续预训练和知识编辑的人，这个视角有参考意义，因为它提示了样本顺序、规则层级和例外密度会影响模型最终形成的是“可细化的抽象”还是“难以打碎的粗类型”。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 lifted representation hypothesis：模型会把多个观测映射到共享潜变量 H，再由 H 决定标签或后果，而不是只记 x→y 的实例映射。与普通泛化不同，这里关心的是“哪些样本被归到同一个 H 里”。当后续证据表明这个 H 太粗时，模型需要做 shattering，也就是把原先的共享类型细分成更具体、且仍然后果一致的子类型。

方法上，论文构造了受控的 exception-learning 任务，分别测试两种方向：general-to-specific，即先给一般规则再给例外，看模型能否把已有抽象打碎；specific-to-general，即先给细粒度规则再给更一般的归纳，看模型能否向上提升成共享结构。实验覆盖 in-context learning、LoRA 和 full fine-tuning 三种更新机制。理论上，作者还用梯度对齐解释 lifting 为什么会发生：如果一批样本的梯度内积整体为正，共享更新方向更高效，模型就更倾向于把它们压到同一潜在结构里。这不是严格的机制证明，但给出了一个和训练动力学相连的解释。
summary.experiments: 核心实验结论是：模型更擅长 bottom-up lifting，不擅长 top-down shattering。也就是，先看到若干具体规则，再归纳成更一般结构，通常比“先学到一个大类，再在后面加入例外并重分类型”更容易。这个现象在 ICL、LoRA、全参微调三种设定下都出现，说明它不像某一种训练范式的偶然产物，更像共享表示修正本身的难点。论文还讨论了嵌套规则和例外层级更深时，shattering failure 会更明显。若想快速把握结果，重点看不同暴露顺序下的准确率对比，以及作者如何区分“没见够例子”与“已有抽象难以重写”这两种失败来源。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Methods，把 lifting / shattering 的定义吃透，再看实验设计图，理解 general-to-specific 与 specific-to-general 的差别。随后直接看主结果图表，关注三种学习机制下是否都呈现同样趋势。若时间有限，20-30 分钟足够抓住主线。值得深挖的点有两个：一是梯度对齐解释是否能推广到真实预训练语料；二是这种“先形成粗抽象、后续难以打碎”的现象，是否能解释持续预训练或知识编辑中的顽固错误。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs tend to store observations through shared latent rule-like structures rather than isolated instance memories, and whether they can later refine an overly coarse shared structure when exceptions appear.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is conceptual rather than algorithmic. It offers a useful lens on how abstraction forms and why abstraction revision can fail. The key idea is that learning may favor shared latent structures when examples have aligned gradients, but those same shared structures become hard to revise once exceptions arrive. That has implications for curriculum design, continual pretraining, data ordering, and model editing: the final representation may depend not only on what data the model sees, but also on whether the data encourages a coarse shared type that later resists refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The authors propose the lifted representation hypothesis: instead of memorizing each x→y mapping independently, an LLM often maps multiple observations into a shared latent representation H, and predicts outcomes through H. This is different from standard generalization. The focus is not only whether a rule transfers, but how examples are assigned to a common internal type in the first place.

When later evidence shows that H was too coarse, the model must perform shattering: refine the original shared type into more specific subtypes without destroying valid prior rules. To test this, the paper builds controlled exception-learning tasks with two exposure orders. In general-to-specific settings, the model first sees a broad rule and later receives exceptions; success requires shattering. In specific-to-general settings, the model first sees fine-grained cases and later benefits from forming a broader abstraction; success reflects lifting.

The study evaluates this across in-context learning, LoRA, and full fine-tuning. The paper also gives a gradient-alignment argument for why lifting is attractive during learning: if examples share positive cross-gradient interactions, a shared update direction is efficient, making a common latent structure more likely to emerge. This is not a mechanistic proof, but it ties the hypothesis to optimization dynamics in a meaningful way.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is asymmetric behavior: models are better at bottom-up lifting than top-down shattering. In other words, they more reliably build a broader abstraction from specific examples than revise an existing broad abstraction after exceptions are introduced. This pattern appears across in-context learning, LoRA, and full fine-tuning, which suggests that the difficulty is not specific to one adaptation method.

The paper further shows that shattering failures become more pronounced when the rule structure is nested or when exceptions require finer-grained retyping. A useful part of the experimental design is that it tries to separate two failure modes: lack of evidence versus inability to revise a shared internal structure. For a quick read, focus on the accuracy comparisons under different exposure orders and on the analyses that support this distinction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read the introduction and method section first to get the definitions of lifting and shattering exactly right. Then jump to the task setup and the main result figures comparing general-to-specific versus specific-to-general exposure. After that, inspect the results across ICL, LoRA, and full fine-tuning to see whether the asymmetry is consistent.

If time is limited, 20–30 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. The two deeper questions worth keeping in mind are: whether the gradient-alignment story scales to realistic pretraining corpora, and whether this failure mode helps explain persistent errors in continual pretraining or model editing, where a model seems to cling to an earlier coarse abstraction.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计即可；“过早 lifting + shattering failure”是可转成数据课程和 finetune 诊断的机制假设。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental setup; premature lifting plus shattering failure is a mechanism hypothesis that can inform data curriculum and finetuning diagnostics.

paper.title: What does a Bayes-filtered transformer believe? A predictive Monte Carlo approach
paper.abstract: A Bayes-filtered transformer (BFT) is a transformer trained on sequences that are generated in two steps: first a latent task is drawn from a prior, then observations are drawn conditional on that task. Trained under autoregressive log loss, the BFT's next-token prediction, in the idealized limit, is the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution (PPD) induced by that prior and that conditional law. In practice the trained BFT is only an approximation of this ideal PPD, raising an interpretive q

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答：在带潜变量任务分布的序列生成环境里，一个按自回归损失训练的 transformer 到底内化了什么样的先验与后验，而不仅仅是它输出了什么预测均值。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它碰的是 in-context learning 与贝叶斯解释之间一个常见但不稳的环节：只比较 next-token prediction 往往无法区分不同的内部推断机制。贡献类型主要是原理分析与识别方法改进，而不是新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 Bayes-filtered transformer 视为近似某个 posterior predictive distribution 的模型，指出现有做法只在 prediction space 里拿若干 reference posterior 做比对，会遇到不同后验给出相同 posterior mean prediction 的不可辨识问题。为此引入 predictive Monte Carlo，把模型预测解释为对潜变量后验的采样式近似，从而反推出模型更接近哪类内部信念表示。核心是从“输出分布像谁”转到“隐含后验像谁”的识别框架。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点应是构造潜变量序列任务，比较 PMC 识别与传统 prediction-matching 在区分不同参考后验时的稳定性与分辨率。未见大规模 LLM、预训练语料或参数规模信息，因此更像小型可控 setup 的机制论文，而非直接可迁移到基座训练的实证报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what prior and posterior beliefs a Bayes-filtered transformer actually internalizes in latent-task sequence settings, beyond merely matching its next-token predictions.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in tightening a weak link in Bayesian interpretations of in-context learning: matching predictive distributions alone often cannot identify the underlying inference algorithm. This is primarily a mechanistic/analytical contribution rather than a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors treat a Bayes-filtered transformer as an approximation to a posterior predictive distribution induced by a latent-task prior, then argue that prediction-space comparisons against reference posteriors are non-identifiable because distinct posteriors can share the same posterior-mean predictions. They introduce predictive Monte Carlo as a more general probe to infer which posterior-like belief state the trained model is implicitly representing.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments likely use controlled latent-variable sequence tasks to compare PMC against standard prediction matching in terms of robustness and identifiability. No large-scale LLM, pretraining corpus, or model-scale evidence is indicated, so this reads as a clean small-scale mechanism study rather than a directly deployable foundation-model recipe.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但它提醒你别再用 next-token 均值去臆测模型“信念”；若你做 ICL/贝叶斯解释，只看方法设定和识别失败案例就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is a useful warning against inferring model beliefs from next-token means alone; if you work on ICL/Bayesian interpretations, read the setup and the identifiability failure cases.

paper.title: In-context learning of closed form solution to simple linear regression task using transformer with linear self-attention
paper.abstract: In-context learning is a remarkable property of transformers and has recently received a lot of interest. In many studies of in-context learning, it has been shown that transformers are capable of implementing solver for linear and non-linear regression problems, in which the most of them implement gradient descent algorithm. However, it is still unclear whether those implementations have actually been acquired through training. In this paper, we construct a transformer with linear self-attentio

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“Transformer 能不能表示线性回归求解器”，而是更具体的问题：在一个可控的简单线性回归 in-context learning 设定里，训练后的 Transformer 到底学到的是类似梯度下降的迭代算法，还是直接接近最小二乘闭式解的解析计算。已有不少工作证明 attention 可以实现梯度下降式更新，也有理论构造说明某些 Transformer 能表示 ridge regression 的闭式解，但“训练过程是否真的把模型推向这种解析求解器”一直不清楚。作者把问题收缩到最简单的一维线性回归，并显式构造一个极小的线性 self-attention Transformer，说明它可以借助 layer normalization 近似完成闭式解里最关键的除法项，再用训练实验检验这种机制是否会自然出现。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在于任务本身，而在于它给 ICL 机制研究补了一块较细的证据：Transformer 在某些分布受控、结构简单的任务上，学到的未必是“用 attention 模拟几步优化”，也可能是更接近解析统计量计算的电路。这个区分很重要，因为它关系到大家如何理解 ICL 的算法归纳偏好：是偏向通用迭代优化器，还是会在合适归纳偏置下收敛到更短路径的闭式程序。论文的贡献量级不大，属于机制层面的窄问题推进；但它把 layer norm 在“实现除法/归一化”中的角色讲得更具体，这对理解 Transformer 中非线性归一化层在算法实现里的作用有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是显式构造。作者考虑 simple linear regression 的 in-context prompt：前面给出 N 个样本对，最后给一个 query x，目标是输出最小二乘估计对应的预测值。模型结构很小：输入线性变换 + 两层 Transformer block + flatten + 输出线性层；每个 block 由 multi-head linear self-attention、layer normalization 和 skip connection 组成。关键点不在 attention 本身，而在如何把最小二乘闭式解中的分子、分母拆成可由 attention 和 LN 近似实现的量。在线性回归里，斜率估计需要协方差除以方差。乘法与求和可以由线性 attention 聚合上下文样本得到，但“除以样本方差”这一步通常是闭式解与梯度法的分水岭。作者沿用前人关于 LN 可近似实现除法的思路，把输入排布成一种自然格式，使得 LN 对特定通道的标准化近似承担了分母归一化的角色，从而在极小网络中拼出近似 least-squares predictor。

第二部分是训练验证。作者不是只给存在性构造，而是训练一个同型网络去拟合最小二乘目标，并加入 ℓ1 正则。这里 ℓ1 正则的作用，是鼓励网络收缩到更稀疏、更接近手工构造的参数解，而不是走向许多功能等价但难解释的实现。随后作者比较训练得到的参数与理论构造的对应关系，论证网络主要采用了闭式解电路，而不是多步梯度下降式近似。这个论证路径和以往“证明能表示某算法”不同，它更接近 mechanistic identification：先给可解释电路，再看训练是否会找到它。
summary.experiments: 实验部分规模很小，重点是机制验证而不是性能竞赛。文中明确给出的构造网络只有 2 层、2 个 attention heads、hidden dimension 为 4，属于极简设置。训练目标是让模型输出 simple regression 的 least-squares estimate，对训练后的参数进行数值检查。作者声称，在加入 ℓ1 regularization 的训练下，模型学到的主要是他们构造的闭式解实现，而不是梯度下降步骤。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格和数值结果，能确认的关键信息主要有三点：一是任务是一维简单回归而非高维线性回归；二是模型极小，因此结果更像“可识别的算法电路”而不是大模型经验现象；三是实验目标不是比较 test error，而是验证训练后参数与闭式解构造的一致性。若看全文，重点应检查作者是否给出了参数恢复、不同正则强度下的解形态变化、以及与无 LN 或不同归一化方式的对照；这些才决定“闭式解被学到”这个结论有多扎实。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Introduction 把问题边界看清：它研究的是 ICL 机制，不是提升回归性能。然后直接看构造部分，重点盯住最小二乘闭式解被拆成哪些中间量、每个量由哪一层/哪一个 head 计算、LN 在哪里承担了近似除法。若只想抓核心，优先看模型结构图、理论构造对应的参数形式，以及训练后参数与构造参数的对照实验。最后再看实验部分，判断作者是否真的排除了“网络只是学了另一种等价近似算法”的可能。预计 20–30 分钟能读完主线；若要深挖，可手推一遍一维 least squares 闭式解与 LN 标准化之间的对应关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more interesting question than mere expressivity: in a controlled in-context simple linear regression setting, does a trained transformer actually learn a gradient-descent-like solver, or can it converge to a circuit that approximates the closed-form least-squares solution? Prior work showed that attention can implement iterative optimization, and some theory established representability of closed-form regression solvers. What remained unclear was whether training naturally selects such an analytic solver. The authors reduce the problem to one-dimensional linear regression, construct a tiny transformer with linear self-attention that can approximate the least-squares predictor, and then test whether training recovers that mechanism.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly mechanistic rather than practical. The paper adds evidence that in-context learning should not always be interpreted as implicit gradient descent. Under a simple enough task distribution and architecture, the learned computation may instead resemble direct estimation of sufficient statistics followed by normalization, i.e. something closer to an analytic estimator than an optimizer. That matters for how one thinks about algorithm induction in transformers. The contribution is modest in scope, but the treatment of layer normalization as a computational primitive for division/normalization is a useful detail for anyone studying how transformers realize algorithms internally.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two parts: an explicit construction and a training-based validation. In the construction, the prompt contains N in-context examples from a simple linear regression problem plus a query input x, and the model must output the least-squares prediction. The architecture is deliberately tiny: an input linear map, two transformer blocks, a flatten layer, and an output linear map. Each block uses multi-head linear self-attention, layer normalization, and a residual connection. The central issue is how to realize the denominator in the least-squares formula. Products and sums over context examples are easy to obtain with linear attention, but the closed-form estimator also requires division by the sample variance. The authors build on earlier observations that layer normalization can approximate division, and arrange the input representation so that LN effectively performs the required normalization on selected channels. This yields a small circuit that approximates the closed-form least-squares predictor rather than an iterative optimizer.

The second part asks whether training actually finds this circuit. The authors train the same architecture to predict the least-squares target and add an L1 regularizer. The role of L1 is to bias learning toward a sparse, interpretable solution closer to the hand-designed construction, instead of one of many functionally equivalent but opaque parameterizations. They then compare the trained parameters with the theoretical construction and argue that the learned model mainly uses the closed-form computation rather than a gradient-descent-like procedure. This is the distinctive part of the paper: not just showing existence, but proposing an interpretable circuit and checking whether optimization recovers it.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are small and diagnostic. The explicitly constructed model has 2 layers, 2 attention heads, and hidden dimension 4. The task is one-dimensional simple regression, and the target is the least-squares estimate. The main empirical claim is that, when trained with L1 regularization, the network converges to a parameter configuration that largely matches the closed-form construction. The emphasis is not benchmark accuracy but mechanism identification. From the provided text, the recoverable concrete facts are: the setup is simple regression rather than general multivariate regression; the network is intentionally minimal; and the evaluation is about whether the trained solution aligns with the analytic circuit. When reading the full paper, the key things to verify are whether the authors provide parameter-level comparisons, ablations over regularization strength, and controls without LN or with altered normalization. Those details determine how convincing the “training learns the closed-form solver” claim really is.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to fix the question: it is about the mechanism of in-context learning, not better regression performance. Then jump to the construction section and track how the least-squares formula is decomposed into intermediate quantities, which head computes what, and exactly where layer normalization acts as approximate division. If time is limited, focus on the architecture description, the hand-crafted parameter construction, and the comparison between trained and constructed parameters. Read the experiments last, mainly to judge whether alternative algorithmic explanations were ruled out. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough for the main line; more if you want to manually derive the correspondence between least-squares normalization and LN.

recommendation.zh: 读构造和实验例子就够；它提醒 ICL≠梯度下降，但 toy setup 太窄，不能外推到大模型预训练动态。
recommendation.en: Read the construction and the trained-example section; it is a useful warning that ICL is not always gradient descent, but the toy setup is too narrow to extrapolate to large-scale pretraining.

paper.title: Partition, Prompt, Aggregate: Statistical Self-Consistency in Language Models
paper.abstract: In-context learning is commonly interpreted as a form of conditional inference, in which the prompt specifies a context and the model's output is treated as an estimate of the corresponding conditional distribution. If this interpretation holds, then LLM estimates should satisfy basic probabilistic identities. In particular, the law of total probability asserts that prior-weighted conditional distributions aggregate into population-level marginals over any valid partition of the population. In t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文检验一个常被默认接受的假设：LLM 的 in-context learning 是否真的像条件概率推断一样工作，特别是在 persona prompting 中，模型给出的子群体估计能否按全概率公式聚合回总体估计。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评测和机制理解。它不是改进预训练 recipe 的工作，但它提出了一个干净的统计一致性测试：如果模型在 prompt 条件下输出的是条件分布估计，那么不同 partition 下的条件估计应当和直接总体估计一致。这个视角可用于分析 ICL 的概率校准、persona prompting 的可靠性，以及模型内部世界知识在不同上下文粒度下是否稳定。对基座模型评估来说，它比单点 accuracy 更接近“模型是否形成可组合的分布估计”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法用二叉树构造人口子群体 partition。根节点是基础 population，每一层用一个二元属性继续划分，例如年龄、就业状态或其他人口属性。每个节点都被转成自然语言 persona description，再要求 LLM 估计某个二元事件的概率，例如收入是否超过某个阈值。由于每一层节点构成对根 population 的合法划分，作者可以用真实或给定的 prior weight 对各子群体条件估计做加权求和，并和模型对根节点的直接估计比较。若两者差异大，就说明模型估计违反全概率公式。persona 数据还允许引入 ground-truth population statistics，把 self-consistency 和 external alignment 分开评估。
summary.experiments: 材料中能确认的实验框架包括：递归构造 binary conditioning tree；对每个节点用 ICL/persona prompt elicitation 得到 LLM 概率估计；在每一层按子群体 prior 加权重建 aggregate；比较重建 aggregate 与根节点直接估计，同时比较它们与真实人口统计数据。论文报告称会观察系统性 self-consistency violation，但给出的正文片段没有包含具体模型列表、数据源、误差数值、树深度设置或各类 ablation 结果。因此更适合把它视为一种评测协议和诊断工具，而不是直接得出某个模型强弱结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和方法部分，重点看 Figure 1、公式 (1)、binary tree 如何生成 partition、prior weight 如何获得、LLM 概率如何 elicitation。预计 20–30 分钟可以把核心方法读完。如果继续深入，优先看实验中 self-consistency error 的定义、不同 tree depth 下误差变化、direct marginal estimate 与 partition-aggregated estimate 谁更接近 ground truth，以及 prompt wording 是否显著影响结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether in-context learning behaves like conditional probabilistic inference. In particular, it asks whether LLM estimates elicited under persona prompts satisfy the law of total probability when subpopulation-level estimates are aggregated back to the population level.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly diagnostic. This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it offers a clean way to probe whether a model’s contextual estimates are compositionally consistent. If a prompt-conditioned answer is treated as an estimate of a conditional distribution, then estimates over any valid partition should aggregate to the corresponding marginal. Violations expose a failure mode that is not captured by ordinary accuracy metrics. The idea is useful for studying ICL, calibration, persona prompting, and the stability of model knowledge under changes in conditioning granularity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The evaluation scaffold is a binary conditioning tree. The root represents a base population. Each split introduces a binary attribute, producing increasingly specific subpopulations. Every node is verbalized as a persona or context description, and the model is prompted to estimate the probability of a binary event, such as whether income exceeds a threshold. At any fixed tree depth, the nodes form a valid partition of the root population. The authors then reconstruct the population-level estimate by prior-weighted aggregation of the node-level conditional estimates and compare it with the model’s direct root-level estimate. When human reference statistics are available, they also compare both estimates against ground truth, separating self-consistency from external alignment.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided text, the confirmed experimental design includes recursive binary partitioning, persona-prompted probability elicitation at each node, aggregation using partition weights, and comparison against both direct marginal estimates and ground-truth population statistics. The paper reports systematic self-consistency violations as the main phenomenon under study. The excerpt does not provide the full model list, dataset details, numerical error magnitudes, tree depths, or ablation results, so the safest reading is that the paper contributes an evaluation protocol and a set of diagnostic observations rather than a model-improvement method.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction, Figure 1, equation (1), and the experimental setup. The key details are how the binary trees define valid partitions, how prior weights are obtained, and how probabilities are elicited from the model. A 20–30 minute read should be enough to understand the method. If going deeper, focus on the definition of self-consistency error, error trends with tree depth, whether aggregated or direct estimates better match ground truth, and the sensitivity to prompt wording.

recommendation.zh: 实验设计干净，直接检验ICL作为贝叶斯推断的核心假设，结论对理解LLM概率估计偏差有参考，重点看§3实验设计和§4结果。
recommendation.en: Clean experimental design directly testing the core assumption of ICL as Bayesian inference; focus on §3 setup and §4 results for insights on LLM probability estimation bias.

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen

paper.title: Agentic Context Learning with Self-Discovered Specification
paper.abstract: Context learning is an emerging inference-time task where LLMs must learn and apply novel, task-specific knowledge from intricate contexts absent from pre-training; even frontier models score under 24% task success. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study to understand why this setting remains difficult. A natural hypothesis is that failures stem from content access; yet across twelve retrieval, reflection, and verification baselines on CL-Bench, an extensive context learning be

summary.core_problem: 上下文学习（context learning）要求 LLM 从长上下文中学习并应用全新的任务特定知识，但前沿模型严格通过率仍低于 24%。传统假设认为失败源于内容检索不足，但实验显示检索、反思、验证等 12 类方法几乎无增益，核心瓶颈实际是「局部规范获取」——模型需要从上下文中发现并遵守查询隐含、低显著度、分散分布的行为约束（格式、边界处理、标签、完整性条件等），而非仅提取与查询相关的事实内容。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：长上下文能力的评测与训练不能只关注内容检索/理解，必须同时覆盖「规范获取」维度。当前预训练数据与目标函数（next-token 预测）对低显著度、分散式约束的学习激励不足，这解释了为何长上下文模型在真实部署中常出现「几乎正确但因细节违规失败」的 near-miss 现象。该结论可直接指导预训练数据构造（增加规范密集型文档）、训练目标设计（强化约束遵守信号）以及长上下文能力评测指标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 首先在 CL-Bench（1899 个长上下文、抗污染任务）上评测 12 种基线方法，覆盖检索与上下文重构、测试时自纠错、自生成规则验证、迭代检索扩展四类，确认内容访问不是瓶颈。随后对 31592 条 rubric 条目做分类，量化规范获取（55.4%）与内容获取（22.6%）的占比，并分析规范的查询隐含性（仅 23.3% 可从查询直接推断，76.7% 仅存在于上下文）与可恢复性（95.5% 可通过显式归纳从上下文中提取）。基于此提出极简干预方案 PSCI（私有规范契约归纳）：四步测试时脚手架——1）从上下文归纳任务特定的规范契约；2）在契约约束下生成答案；3）对抗式检查器对照契约审计草稿；4）修复违规项。整个过程不访问任务公开 rubric。
summary.experiments: 关键结果：1）12 种内容访问导向基线中，最优方法仅比直接全上下文提示基线（22.55% 严格通过率）提升不超过 1 个百分点；2）任务级严格通过率仅 22.55%，但 rubric 条目级通过率达 76.01%，失败多为单条关键规范遗漏的 near-miss；在仅差 1 条 rubric 的失败案例中，75.3% 遗漏的是行为规范而非事实内容；3）PSCI 在 GPT-5.1 上达到 28.14% 严格通过率，相对基线提升 5.59 个百分点（+24.8% 相对提升），在四类任务家族上均有一致增益；在 Qwen3.5-27B 上从 14.14% 提升至 19.42%；4）17 组消融验证了任务特定规范的必要性：打乱契约的 PSCI 低于基线，计算量匹配的通用批评回到基线，答案优先的顺序安排完全失效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：第 3 节 CL-Bench 与 rubric 分类——理解「内容获取 vs 规范获取」的划分依据与量化结果；第 4 节失败分析——看 near-miss 模式与规范的查询隐含性数据；第 5.2 节基线对比与 5.4 节消融实验——确认内容访问方法的失效边界与 PSCI 各组件的贡献。预计阅读时间 50-60 分钟。对预训练研究员，值得深挖的点是：next-token 目标为何对分散式低显著度约束学习不足，以及如何在预训练阶段注入规范遵守信号（而非仅依赖测试时脚手架）。

summary_en.core_problem: Context learning requires LLMs to acquire and apply novel task-specific knowledge from long contexts, yet frontier models still achieve below 24% strict task success. The conventional hypothesis attributes failures to insufficient content retrieval, but experiments show 12 classes of methods spanning retrieval, reflection, and verification deliver almost no gain. The actual bottleneck is specification acquisition: models must discover and comply with query-implicit, low-salience, scattered behavioral constraints (formats, edge-case handling, labels, completeness conditions, etc.) distributed across the context, rather than only extracting query-relevant factual content.
summary_en.importance: Implications for pretraining research: long-context capability evaluation and training cannot focus solely on content retrieval/understanding — specification acquisition must be covered as a separate dimension. Current pretraining data and the next-token prediction objective provide insufficient incentive for learning low-salience, distributed constraints, which explains the pervasive near-miss failure pattern in real long-context deployments (mostly correct but invalid due to minor rule violations). These findings directly inform pretraining data construction (adding specification-dense documents), training objective design (strengthening constraint-compliance signals), and long-context evaluation metric design.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, 12 baseline methods across four families — retrieval & context restructuring, test-time self-correction, self-generated rubric verification, and iterative retrieval scaling — are evaluated on CL-Bench (1,899 long-context, contamination-controlled tasks), confirming content access is not the bottleneck. Next, 31,592 rubric items are taxonomized to quantify the share of specification acquisition (55.4%) versus content acquisition (22.6%), and to analyze query-implicitness (only 23.3% of specs are directly inferable from the query, 76.7% exist only in context) and recoverability (95.5% can be extracted from context via explicit induction). Based on this diagnosis, a deliberately simple intervention called PSCI (Private Specification-Contract Induction) is proposed: a four-step test-time scaffold — 1) induce a task-specific specification contract from the context; 2) generate the answer under contract constraints; 3) an adversarial checker audits the draft against the contract; 4) a repair step fixes violations. The public task rubric is never accessed at any stage.
summary_en.experiments: Key results: 1) Among 12 content-access-oriented baselines, the best method improves upon the direct full-context prompt baseline (22.55% strict pass) by no more than 1 percentage point; 2) Task-level strict pass is only 22.55%, but rubric-item-level pass reaches 76.01% — most failures are near-misses missing exactly one critical item; among failures missing exactly one rubric item, 75.3% miss behavioral specifications rather than factual content; 3) PSCI achieves 28.14% strict pass on GPT-5.1, a +5.59 pp absolute (+24.8% relative) improvement over baseline, with consistent gains across all four task families; on Qwen3.5-27B, it improves from 14.14% to 19.42%; 4) 17 ablations validate the necessity of task-specific specifications: shuffled contracts collapse below baseline, compute-matched generic critique returns to baseline, and answer-first ordering fails entirely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 3 on CL-Bench and rubric taxonomy — understand the rationale and quantitative results of the 'content acquisition vs specification acquisition' distinction; Section 4 failure analysis — examine the near-miss pattern and query-implicitness data for specifications; Section 5.2 baseline comparison and 5.4 ablations — confirm the failure boundary of content-access methods and the contribution of each PSCI component. Estimated reading time: 50-60 minutes. For pretraining researchers, a worthwhile direction to dig deeper is why the next-token objective under-learns distributed, low-salience constraints, and how to inject specification-compliance signals during pretraining rather than relying solely on test-time scaffolding.

recommendation.zh: 失败分析有信息量：上下文学习的瓶颈不在检索而在隐式规范提取，对预训练数据设计与ICL机制研究有参考，重点看失败分析章节。
recommendation.en: Informative failure analysis: context learning bottleneck lies in implicit spec extraction, not retrieval. Relevant for pretraining data design and ICL mechanism studies; focus on the failure analysis section.

paper.title: Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks
paper.abstract: We present a theoretical framework to explain the emergence of inductive reasoning abilities in Transformer language models. While previous works on Transformer learning dynamics have so far been mostly tied to specific tasks, we study a generalized class of inductive tasks that unifies several synthetic tasks known in the literature, including in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning. In this class, we theoretically prove that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined to a hig

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解释 Transformer 在归纳推理任务中如何形成可用 circuit，尤其是 in-context learning、in-weights learning 以及多个归纳 circuit 在训练中的竞争关系。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值在于提供了一个可分析的训练动态框架。大模型能力涌现通常难以直接从参数空间理解，作者把一类归纳任务的训练轨迹限制到低维 invariant manifold 上，使 circuit 形成、数据分布影响和初始化影响变得可推导。它不会直接给出预训练 recipe，但能帮助理解为什么某些数据分布更容易诱发 ICL，为什么相同架构在不同初始化下可能学到不同机制。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义了一类 generalized block-list inductive tasks，用 token block 之间的关系来统一 in-context n-grams、multi-hop reasoning 等合成任务。核心理论对象是 IMIR，即 Invariant Manifold of Inductive Reasoning。若模型参数位于该流形上，用梯度下降更新后仍会留在流形上。这样，原本高维的 Transformer 参数动态可以被少数可解释坐标描述；每个坐标对应某个组件中的基本操作。基于这个低维描述，论文分析两类竞争：一类是 ICL circuit 与 in-weights learning 的竞争，并证明数据分布会影响 ICL 的出现；另一类是单个 Transformer 内多个 ICL circuit 的竞争，结果显示获胜 circuit 由初始化区域决定，并存在较尖锐的相变边界。论文还利用 IMIR 的结构做自动 inductive circuit detection。
summary.experiments: 实验和理论都集中在合成归纳任务上，不是大规模语言模型预训练。关键结果包括：证明 IMIR 的存在和梯度下降下的不变性；在低维坐标中复现并解释 circuit competition；展示数据分布如何改变 ICL 与权重记忆之间的偏好；展示不同随机初始化会把训练导向不同 ICL circuit，并出现 phase transition；最后给出基于 IMIR 坐标的 circuit 检测方法。给定内容没有包含具体模型规模、样本量和数值指标，适合把它当作机制分析论文阅读，而不是工程 recipe。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到精读之间，预计 45–60 分钟。先看 Section 2 的任务定义，确认这些 block-list tasks 如何覆盖 n-gram induction 和 multi-hop reasoning；再看 Section 3 的 IMIR 定义与不变性证明，这是核心；Section 4 值得仔细读，因为它把数据分布、初始化和 circuit competition 联系起来；Section 5 可快速看方法思路，重点是它如何把低维坐标用于自动检测 circuit。若只关心预训练工程，可跳过部分证明细节，保留对数据分布和初始化敏感性的结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how Transformer circuits for inductive reasoning emerge during training. The focus is on the dynamics behind in-context learning, in-weights learning, and competition among multiple possible induction circuits.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is mechanistic rather than recipe-level. The paper offers a low-dimensional description of training dynamics for a broad class of synthetic induction tasks, making it possible to analyze how data distributions and initialization shape the learned mechanism. This is useful for thinking about skill acquisition in language models: the same architecture can learn different circuits, and the training data can bias the model toward either contextual rule inference or memorized weight-based solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define a generalized class of block-list inductive tasks that covers settings such as in-context n-grams and multi-hop induction. The main object is the Invariant Manifold of Inductive Reasoning, or IMIR. If the model parameters lie on this manifold, gradient descent keeps them on it. This reduces the effective training dynamics from a high-dimensional Transformer parameter space to a small set of interpretable coordinates, where each coordinate corresponds to an elementary action inside a Transformer component. Using this reduction, the paper analyzes competition between in-context learning and in-weights learning, proves distributional dependence of ICL in the simplified setting, and studies competition among multiple ICL circuits. The winning circuit is determined by the initialization region, with sharp phase transitions between regions. The same structure is then used for automatic detection of inductive circuits.
summary_en.experiments: The results are based on theory and controlled synthetic tasks, not large-scale language model pretraining. The central claims are the existence and invariance of IMIR under gradient descent, low-dimensional explanations of circuit competition, data-dependent emergence of ICL, initialization-dependent selection among induction circuits, and a circuit detection procedure derived from the IMIR coordinates. The provided content does not include exact model sizes, dataset sizes, or numerical metrics, so the paper should be read as a mechanistic analysis rather than an engineering training guide.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 45–60 minute read is appropriate. Start with the task definition in Section 2 to understand how the block-list formulation unifies n-gram induction and multi-hop reasoning. Then read Section 3 carefully, since the IMIR definition and invariance theorem are the main contribution. Section 4 is the most relevant part for pretraining intuition because it connects data distribution, initialization, and circuit competition. Section 5 can be skimmed for the circuit detection idea. Readers focused on training practice can skip some proof details while retaining the lessons about distributional and initialization sensitivity.

recommendation.zh: 合成任务上的干净动力学分析，核心是低维流形结论，读§3理论推导和§5的ICL/权重学习竞争分析即可，无需啃全部证明。
recommendation.en: A clean dynamics analysis on synthetic tasks; focus on the low-dimensional manifold conclusion in §3 and ICL/in-weights competition analysis in §5, skip full proofs if short on time.

paper.title: Sparse Delta Memory: Scaling the State of Linear RNNs through Sparsity
paper.abstract: Linear attention models allow a fixed state size and a fixed amount of compute per token. However, due to their limited state size, linear attention models fall behind in long-context recall compared to softmax-attention-based transformer architectures. Increasing the state size of linear attention improves recall performance but at the cost of higher FLOPs. In this work, we introduce Sparse Delta Memory (SDM), an architecture that scales the hidden state of gated linear RNNs to orders of magnit

summary.core_problem: 线性RNN与线性注意力模型（如Gated DeltaNet、Mamba）采用固定大小的稠密隐状态压缩历史信息，单token计算和内存开销恒定，但稠密状态更新的FLOP开销与状态大小成正比，限制了状态容量扩展，导致这类模型的长上下文召回能力始终弱于使用KV缓存的Transformer；而KV缓存随序列长度线性增长的开销，又限制了超长序列场景的落地。
summary.importance: 为线性RNN类架构的状态容量scaling提供了低开销的稀疏化路径，在不增加单token计算量的前提下可将状态容量提升三个数量级，补上了线性RNN长上下文能力弱的核心短板，对长程Agent记忆、超长序列建模、长视频处理等需要恒定推理成本的场景有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Gated DeltaNet的delta更新规则做稀疏化改造：原GDN的读写操作是对稠密状态矩阵做键值外积更新，计算复杂度为O(dqk×dv)，状态大小线性提升会直接带来FLOP增长。SDM借用Product-Key Memory的子乘积索引方案，将键空间拆分为两个子码本，通过外和生成大规模记忆槽索引，仅对top-k个选中的记忆槽执行稀疏读写，避免稠密矩阵计算的开销。同时支持可学习的初始记忆状态，用于存储预训练阶段习得的通用知识。
summary.experiments: 在等FLOP、等参数量的对比设置下，SDM的状态大小可比稠密Gated DeltaNet高三个数量级。在8B激活参数规模、超过1万亿token的预训练设置下，SDM的训练loss低于同规模GDN，短上下文精度略优于全注意力Transformer；在RULER长上下文召回基准、100万token长度的上下文学习任务上，SDM性能显著超过GDN；可学习初始记忆状态可有效编码预训练知识，跨多个标准任务带来稳定性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分的问题定义、图1展示的FLOP与状态容量的权衡关系、核心架构中稀疏读写对GDN的改造点、8B规模的预训练对比结果。如果已经熟悉Product-Key Memory的索引机制，可以跳过对应的实现细节部分。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Linear RNN and linear attention models (e.g., Gated DeltaNet, Mamba) compress historical information into fixed-size dense hidden states, delivering constant per-token compute and memory cost. However, dense state updates incur FLOPs proportional to state size, which prevents scaling state capacity and leaves these models consistently underperforming KV-cache Transformers on long-context recall. The linearly growing cost of Transformers' KV cache, in turn, limits deployment on extremely long sequences.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces a low-overhead sparsification path to scale state capacity for linear RNNs, enabling three orders of magnitude larger state size without increasing per-token compute. It addresses the core long-context weakness of linear recurrent architectures, with practical implications for long-horizon agent memory, ultra-long sequence modeling, and long-form video processing.
summary_en.technical_approach: SDM modifies the update rule of Gated DeltaNet to support sparse operations. Original GDN performs dense key-value outer product updates to the state matrix with O(dqk×dv) complexity, so increasing state size directly increases FLOPs. SDM adopts the Product-Key Memory indexing scheme, splitting the key space into two sub-codebooks to generate a large set of memory slots via outer sum, then only performs read/write operations on top-k selected slots to avoid dense matrix compute. It also supports learnable initial memory states to encode general knowledge acquired during pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: Under iso-FLOP and iso-parameter constraints, SDM achieves three orders of magnitude larger state size than dense Gated DeltaNet. When trained at 8B activated parameter scale on over 1T tokens, SDM reaches lower training loss than GDN and slightly better short-context accuracy than full-attention Transformers. It outperforms GDN by a large margin on RULER long-context recall and 1M-token in-context learning tasks. Learnable initial states deliver consistent performance gains across standard benchmarks by encoding pretrained knowledge.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim level. Focus on the problem framing in the introduction, the FLOP vs state capacity tradeoff in Figure 1, the sparse read/write modification to DeltaNet, and 8B-scale pretraining comparison results. Skip low-level Product-Key Memory implementation details if already familiar with the method. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 线性RNN方向的扎实架构改进，稀疏显式记忆思路对长上下文建模有参考价值，重点读§3稀疏读写机制与§4等FLOP对比实验。
recommendation.en: A solid architectural advance for linear RNNs; the sparse explicit memory idea is informative for long-context modeling, focus on §3 sparse read/write mechanism and §4 isoFLOP comparisons.

paper.title: Tree-of-Thoughts Reasoning for Text-to-Image In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: In text-to-image in-context learning (T2I-ICL), a model has to infer a latent compositional pattern from fewshot demonstrations for generating a query image. Recent studies show that state-of-the-art multimodal large language models struggle with this setting, particularly due to limited compositional reasoning and sensitivity to prompt construction. In this work, we propose a Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) reasoning framework for T2I-ICL that introduces a multi-stage reasoning and selection layer that

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型在文生图上下文学习（T2I-ICL）场景下组合推理能力不足，对prompt构造敏感，易产生歧义与组合错误
summary.importance: 将已有的Tree-of-Thoughts多分支推理框架迁移到T2I-ICL任务，验证了结构化推理对多模态生成ICL的提升效果
summary.technical_approach: 提出ToT-T2IICL推理流水线，在构造最终生图prompt前，先生成多个候选推理假设，经过评估选择最优连贯解释后再输入图像生成模型，属于已有方法的任务迁移，无原创核心模块
summary.experiments: 在CoBSAT基准上开展定性定量评测，结构化多分支推理相比直接prompt基线提升了T2I-ICL的组合生成准确率，未涉及新模型训练或架构改动

summary_en.core_problem: State-of-the-art MLLMs suffer from limited compositional reasoning and high prompt sensitivity in text-to-image in-context learning settings, leading to ambiguity and compositional errors
summary_en.importance: Transfers the existing Tree-of-Thoughts multi-branch reasoning framework to T2I-ICL, verifying the benefit of structured reasoning for multimodal generative ICL
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ToT-T2IICL inference pipeline that generates, evaluates and selects the best coherent hypothesis from multiple candidates before constructing the final image generation prompt; this is a task transfer of existing methods with no novel core components
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on CoBSAT benchmark with qualitative and quantitative results showing multi-branch reasoning outperforms direct prompting baselines on compositional T2I-ICL accuracy; no new model training or architecture changes involved

recommendation.zh: 把已有ToT推理套用到T2I-ICL的增量工作，无新建模洞见，知道多分支推理能提升该任务效果即可，无需读正文
